quasium.progression.introduction.title: How to Read This Book
quasium.progression.introduction.page1: This book grows with you. A new entry opens when you take the next step: find seeds, cut leaves, light your first hookah. Its recipes open together with it, both in the recipe book and on these pages. A locked entry shows a hint and the step that opens it.
quasium.progression.introduction.page2: Not sure how a block or item works? Hover over it in your inventory or in this book and hold the hint key, W by default. After a second a scene opens: blocks assemble in front of you and captions explain each step. You can rebind the key in Controls, under Quasium. Entries with a scene have a Hint button.
quasium.progression.introduction.page3: Where to start: get tobacco seeds. Wild bushes grow on their own: Dikar in plains and forests, Peschanik in deserts, Bolotnik in swamps, Ledyanoy in snowy places and mountains. Break a bush and it gives seeds. Dikar seeds also drop from grass, a 10%% chance.
quasium.progression.tobacco_crops.title: Tobacco Bushes
quasium.progression.tobacco_crops.hint: Wild tobacco bushes grow out there. Find their seeds.
quasium.progression.tobacco_crops.page1: Seeds of wild varieties only go on farmland. The bush grows like wheat and needs light. Splash it with a water bucket: a wet bush grows faster until it dries out. Cut a ripe bush with shears: the leaves drop, the bush steps back one stage and ripens again. A broken bush only gives seeds: 2 from a ripe one, 1 from an unripe one.
quasium.progression.tobacco_crops.page2: A bush has three stars out of five: strength, yield and quality. Peschanik is the strongest, strength 4, but its quality is 2. Bolotnik gives the most leaves, yield 4, and quality 4 as well. Ledyanoy is weak, strength 2, but quality 4. Dikar has 3 everywhere. Yield is the number of leaves per cut, sometimes an extra one drops.
quasium.progression.tobacco_crops.page3: Wild bushes give quality 1, rarely 2. A bush grown from a seed takes the seed's stars, and a plain seed gives the normal stars of its variety. Variety stars pass into leaves and seeds: strength sets the power of a self-mix, and the parents' quality raises the hybrid chance. Leaf quality stars are something else, a leaf gets them at harvest.
quasium.progression.fermentation.title: Fermentation
quasium.progression.fermentation.hint: Dry leaves mature in a barrel.
quasium.progression.fermentation.page1: The fermentation barrel takes up to 16 dry leaves of one kind, put them in with right click. Once loaded, right click it with an empty hand: the barrel closes and the leaves are ready in 60 seconds. Take them out with an empty hand too. Changed your mind before the start? Sneak right click with an empty hand to get the leaves back.
quasium.progression.fermentation.page2: Sugar speeds the barrel up. Before the start each portion cuts 10 seconds, during fermentation it pushes it 20 seconds ahead. The barrel takes three portions at most, and each adds a 15%% risk of spoiling the whole batch. Spoiled leaves won't go into the bowl. A batch without sugar gets a quality star instead, up to 5.
quasium.progression.fermentation.page3: A netherite hammer closes the barrel too, but its real job comes later: forging on the quasium anvil.
quasium.progression.drying_shelf.title: Drying Shelf
quasium.progression.drying_shelf.hint: Raw leaves are no good for the barrel, they need drying.
quasium.progression.drying_shelf.page1: The drying shelf hangs on a wall, on the side of a full block. It holds one item. Put it in with right click, take it out with an empty hand, and sneak right click with an empty hand to see how long is left.
quasium.progression.drying_shelf.page2: A leaf dries in a minute. At 100%% it is dry and ready for the barrel, past 140%% it is overdried. An overdried leaf makes a stronger self-mix. A shelf dries one leaf at a time, so hang several for a batch.
quasium.progression.molasses_chain.title: Molasses
quasium.progression.molasses_chain.hint: Tallow can be brewed into glycerin, and glycerin into molasses.
quasium.progression.molasses_chain.page1: Molasses softens a self-mix. The road to it is long: tallow from a drying shelf, ghast acid, a brewing stand and honey.
quasium.progression.molasses_chain.page2: Glycerin needs ghast acid, and ghast tears come from the Nether.
quasium.progression.molasses_chain.page3: Glycerin is brewed in a brewing stand: acid bottles go below, tallow on top. One piece of tallow converts up to three bottles.
quasium.progression.charcoal.title: Hookah Coals
quasium.progression.charcoal.hint: Plain charcoal won't do for a hookah, you need sized coals.
quasium.progression.charcoal.page1: A hookah is heated by pressed coals. First you mould raw briquettes, then cut them on a stonecutter into coals of three sizes.
quasium.progression.charcoal.page2: 22 mm coal: 3 per briquette, heat 1.0, burns for 3 minutes, takes 3 units of calloud space.
quasium.progression.charcoal.page3: 25 mm coal: 2 per briquette, heat 1.5, burns for 5 minutes, space 4.
quasium.progression.calloud.title: Calloud
quasium.progression.calloud.page1: The calloud holds coals over the bowl. Right click it in the air to open it: 4 bottom slots and 4 top slots, and a top coal only goes on a bottom one. All coals together take at most 12 units of space.
quasium.progression.calloud.page2: A top coal heats half as much as a bottom one. 12 units fit 4 coals of 22 mm, 3 of 25 mm or 2 of 27 mm. The calloud itself needs no heating, you put hot coals into it.
quasium.progression.calloud.page3: Tobacco needs heat: flavored tobacco 1.0, a self-mix 1.5, a self-mix on Peschanik 2.0, a cooler cuts it by 20%%. In the hookah window the heat bar has three colors: yellow is too little, green is the working heat for this tobacco, red is overheat. A pull is at full strength when the coals are heated to at least 60%%.
quasium.progression.heater.title: Hookah Heater
quasium.progression.heater.hint: Coals need heating before you smoke.
quasium.progression.heater.page1: The hookah heater warms coals. It has 15 coal slots and a separate fuel slot for plain charcoal. One piece of fuel burns for 80 seconds, and the heater only takes the next one while there is something to heat.
quasium.progression.heater.page2: Heating runs three times faster than burning: a 22 mm coal heats in a minute, 25 mm in 100 seconds, 27 mm in 160 seconds. The coal's tooltip shows how hot it is. While the fuel burns, the coals burn down in the heater too, so move finished ones into the calloud right away.
quasium.progression.hookah_bowl.title: Hookah Bowl
quasium.progression.hookah_bowl.hint: Tobacco is smoked from a bowl.
quasium.progression.hookah_bowl.page1: A bowl starts as a raw clay blank.
quasium.progression.hookah_bowl.page2: Fired in a furnace, the blank becomes a hookah bowl.
quasium.progression.hookah_bowl.page3: Right click the bowl in the air to open it: 20 slots, 1 g of tobacco each. Burnt tobacco stays in its slot as ash, take it out by hand. More than 15 filled slots, ash included, and the tobacco burns one and a half times faster.
quasium.progression.regular_tobacco.hint: The hookah master and the smoke caravan sell ready flavored tobacco.
quasium.progression.regular_tobacco.page: Flavored tobacco cannot be crafted: the hookah master in a village sells ready packs, and now and then the smoke caravan does too. What you make yourself is a self-mix in the soaking bowl. There are 16 flavors, a pack weighs 30 g, right click in the air pinches off 1 g, and that is what goes into the bowl.

Each flavor gives an effect: mint and anise speed, citrus and cinnamon strength, berry jump boost, apple health boost, watermelon water breathing, grape luck, cherry night vision, vanilla slow falling, coffee haste, coconut resistance, rose regeneration. The effect lasts as long as you pulled, scaled by the flavor's share, and over 70%% of one flavor in the bowl gives level two.
quasium.progression.soaking_bowl.title: Self-Mix
quasium.progression.soaking_bowl.hint: A fermented leaf, an essence and molasses make your own tobacco.
quasium.progression.soaking_bowl.page1: The soaking bowl makes a self-mix, a 30 g pack. Put one fermented leaf in it. Add essence by right clicking with the bottle, 5 ml at a time, up to 20 ml in total, and molasses, up to 4 bottles. You need at least an essence or molasses.
quasium.progression.soaking_bowl.page2: Stir it with a stick and the mix is ready in 30 seconds, every further stir speeds it up by 5 seconds. Take the finished tobacco with an empty bowl. Right click with an empty hand tells you what is missing.
quasium.progression.soaking_bowl.page3: Mix strength comes from the leaf's strength stars: an overdried leaf adds 20%%, molasses and essence dilute it. 20 ml of molasses take off half, 20 ml of essence a tenth. Strong tobacco gives more kaif, and above 0.5 it also raises the effects by a level.
quasium.progression.hookah.title: Hookah
quasium.progression.hookah.hint: A bowl, a calloud and a pipe come together in a hookah.
quasium.progression.hookah.page1: The hookah is crafted on a workbench: 2 iron ingots, 2 copper ingots and 3 glass. That is the plain hookah, a modular one is built from parts, see the next entry.
quasium.progression.hookah.page2: Right click the hookah with an empty hand or any item but the pipe to open it: slots for the calloud, the bowl and three accessories. Right click the hookah with the pipe to attach the hose, no need to sneak anymore. Hold right click with the pipe in hand to pull and release to exhale, even while looking at the hookah. The hose holds while you stay near the hookah and the pipe is somewhere in your inventory, and sneaking with an empty hand and right clicking unhooks it.
quasium.progression.hookah.page3: Once the heat is enough, the hookah hisses and puffs smoke: you can pull. A fresh bowl takes 10 pulls to warm up and gives a fifth of the power, the hookah window shows Warming up 3/10. Once warm, the hookah bubbles, puffs smoke and the action bar says it is at its peak. Trick rings and the smoke jar only work at the peak. With 5 g left it burns out: 70%% power, and now and then a second of pulling takes 1 kaif. Run out of air and the pull breaks off, and the pipe needs 5 seconds to cool.
quasium.progression.hookah.page4: The diffuser raises pull strength by 10%% and makes coals last twice as long.
quasium.progression.kaif_system.title: Kaif
quasium.progression.kaif_system.hint: Smoking gives you something called kaif.
quasium.progression.kaif_system.page1: Kaif lives between -100 and 100. While you pull a hookah it grows every second. The base gain is %s, weak pulls and mild tobacco cut it, and your taste decides the rest, see the flavored tobacco entry.
quasium.progression.kaif_system.page2: Without smoking kaif melts: you lose 1 every 10 seconds. Inside a kaif zone it does not drop, and on a lounge cushion it melts at %s%% of the normal speed. Below zero the body asks for smoke: nausea rolls in, and the deeper the kaif, the more often. Kaif itself creeps back toward zero by 1 every 30 seconds.
quasium.progression.kaif_system.page3: The kaifometer shows your kaif: hold it and a bar appears above the hotbar. Right click a hookah with it to see the heat, the stage and the kaif zone, and it also hears the notes of items and mobs, the zones and notes entries explain.
quasium.progression.kaif_mastery.title: Kaif Mastery
quasium.progression.kaif_mastery.hint: When kaif reaches 30, the world opens up more.
quasium.progression.kaif_mastery.page1: Thirty kaif is serious. From %s the kaifometer hears the notes of mobs, quasium ore gets more generous at 40, 70 and 100 kaif, and anvil recipes open level by level.
quasium.progression.kaif_mastery.page2: The anvil asks for kaif: an empty smoke jar and a clay golem from 30, a calloud golem, the Sommelier Module and the Toolkeeper Module from 40, a backpack hookah and a smoke warden from 50. With too little kaif the anvil tells you how much it needs. Forging does not spend the kaif itself.
quasium.progression.quasium_ore.title: Quasium Ore
quasium.progression.quasium_ore.hint: Deep underground lies an ore that doesn't open for everyone.
quasium.progression.quasium_ore.page1: Quasium ore sits in deepslate, from height 0 down to the bottom of the world, 4 veins per chunk. Mine it with a diamond pickaxe or better.
quasium.progression.quasium_ore.page2: The ore gives raw quasium only if you have at least 10 kaif, otherwise it breaks for nothing. The higher your kaif, the more generous it is: up to 39 kaif 1 piece, from 40 up to 2, from 70 up to 3, at 100 up to 4. Fortune on the pickaxe doesn't help, only kaif counts.
quasium.progression.quasium_ore.page3: Silk Touch takes the ore whole, as a block. You can break it later, when you are in the right mood.
quasium.progression.smelting_quasium.pag: Raw quasium smelts into an ingot in a furnace, and twice as fast in a blast furnace.
Ingots go into the golem staff, the warden blank and draft machines.
quasium.progression.quasium_anvil.title: Quasium Anvil
quasium.progression.quasium_anvil.hint: Quasium can become an anvil for special things.
quasium.progression.quasium_anvil.page1: The quasium anvil forges what a crafting table can't. It has 3 slots and order matters: put items in with right click, they fill from left to right. An item like the last one stacks onto it. An empty hand takes out the whole last slot.
quasium.progression.quasium_anvil.page2: Strike the anvil with a netherite hammer. Each hit costs hammer durability and moves the recipe a step, and every recipe needs its own kaif. The finished item lands in your inventory. Like a regular anvil, it falls if there is nothing under it.
quasium.progression.quasium_anvil.page3: An empty smoke jar carries a kaif zone with you, see the zones entry.
quasium.progression.quasium_armor.title: Quasium Armor
quasium.progression.quasium_armor.hint: Armor is forged on the quasium anvil.
quasium.progression.quasium_armor.page1: Quasium armor: helmet, chestplate, leggings and boots, 24 armor points together. It outlasts iron, toughness 2.0, knockback resistance 0.1.
quasium.progression.quasium_armor.page2: A full set slips into smoke from any damage with a %s%% chance: the hit passes through empty air and every piece loses 1 durability. The void and /kill cannot be fooled this way. The armor also holds up to %s haze charges. If the dodge fails and a hit would take %s%% of your health or more, or kill you, a charge takes it instead. A charge builds up over %s s while your kaif stays at %s or higher.
quasium.progression.backpack_hookah.hint: A hookah can be worn on your back.
quasium.progression.backpack_hookah.page: The backpack hookah is forged on the quasium anvil from leather and a hookah crafted on a workbench.

It goes into its own Curios slot, the Backpack Hookah Slot. B opens it, V attaches and detaches the pipe, both can be rebound in Controls. The pipe never comes off however far you walk: the hookah is always with you.

Inside it works like a regular hookah: calloud, bowl, diffuser, cooler and ice chamber, the same heat thresholds, warm-up and overheat. You can exhale spells from it too. It does not make a kaif zone though: only hookahs standing on the ground and a smoke jar do.

quasium.progression.notes_first_exhale.h: The kaifometer can do more than show your kaif.
quasium.progression.notes_first_exhale.p: Notes sound in everything: every item, block and mob. There are six: Menthol, Ember, Nectar, Dew, Resin and Ash. The kaifometer hears them if you are in the mood: items and blocks from %s kaif, mobs from %s. Click a block or a mob with it, hold an item in your other hand and right click, or right click an item in your inventory with the kaifometer.

The first reading of anything grants insight: %s for an item, %s for a block, %s for a mob, up to %s stored. The notes of studied things then show in their tooltip. Clicking a block also shows the smoke density of its chunk. A thing without notes of its own takes them from its recipe: %s%% of the notes of what it is made of, no more than %s ml of one note. Without a recipe, its material and kind decide. Such notes grant no insight.

The main source of notes is the distillation cube. Pour in water with a bucket or bottles, up to %s ml, add fuel and an item with notes. The cube boils it down, using %s ml of water per item, and the notes collect in gauges, up to %s ml of each. Scoop a note straight from a gauge with an empty bottle, a bottle holds %s ml.
A note jar holds up to %s ml of one note. Pour a bottle in or scoop it back out. Jars stack on top of each other, and a comparator reads how full they are.

The hookah bowl is your focus. Below the tobacco it has three focus slots: the notes and essences you put there decide the spell. A hot bowl can't be recharged by hand: finish it or change the focus on the mixing table. Every cast drains %s ml from each focus bottle and burns grams of tobacco from the bowl, and those count toward an overdose.

A cast is inhale, hold, exhale. Pull on the pipe and your lungs fill up, the bar above the hotbar shows how much, %s ml in total. Once there is enough smoke for the spell you can keep holding, power grows %s%% per second, up to %s%%. Hold for %s seconds and you cough, losing %s kaif along with the smoke. Release the button and the spell flies. Lungs fill up to %s ml per second, slower if the coals are heated below 60%% or the water in the bulb is off.

quasium.progression.smoke_rings.title: Smoke Rings
quasium.progression.smoke_rings.hint: Exhale your first spell to unlock this entry.
quasium.progression.smoke_rings.page1: Blow a ring by holding sneak. While you pull on the pipe with sneak held, a marker sweeps a bar above the hotbar. Let go when it is in the middle: the window is %s ms. Miss by less than %s ms and the ring comes out perfect, it chimes and its power is %s%%.
quasium.progression.smoke_rings.page2: If the focus holds no ring spell, you blow a trick ring. It needs at least a one second pull and a hookah at its peak. Rings less than %s seconds apart build a combo: from the third on each gives %s kaif, and the third also gives %s insight. Five in a row makes you a trickster.
quasium.progression.smoke_rings.page3: A trick ring lives for 5 seconds and works as a lens: exhale a beam or a cone through your own ring and the spell's power becomes %s%%.
quasium.progression.smoke_rings.page4: Ring spells. Shield: Resin, Dew and Menthol. Circles you for 10 seconds and dissolves arrows, fireballs and tridents, each one costs it a second. Trap: two Resin and Ash. Flies up to 16 blocks and holds the first creature it touches for 3 seconds, a boss for one.
quasium.progression.smoke_rings.page5: Portal: two Menthol and Ash. Blow two rings, they link up and for a minute carry anyone who steps in from one to the other, a new pair is ready a minute later. Smoke Step: Menthol and Nectar or a lemon essence. Wherever the ring stops, up to 24 blocks away, that is where you land. With sneak held, ring spells use the timing window too: hit the middle for more power, miss and the ring breaks.
quasium.progression.kaif_zones.title: Kaif Zones
quasium.progression.kaif_zones.hint: Smoke at a hookah and a kaif zone gathers around it.
quasium.progression.kaif_zones.page1: A smoking hookah gathers a kaif zone around it. Its level depends on how many people pulled on pipes in the last %s seconds. One smoker makes Smoke, radius %s: kaif doesn't melt, phantoms stay away, mobs notice you from %s%% closer, and spells cost %s%% less smoke and tobacco.
quasium.progression.kaif_zones.page2: Two smokers or a modular hookah make Haze, radius %s. Kaif grows %s%% faster, you can hold smoke without coughing, and the aroma of the bowl's tobacco kicks in, like an aroma lamp.
quasium.progression.kaif_zones.page3: Three smokers with at least %s pieces of lounge furniture nearby make Nirvana, radius %s: resistance and saturation are added on top. Zones don't stack, the strongest one wins.
quasium.progression.kaif_zones.page4: You can carry Smoke in a jar. Fill an empty jar at a hookah at its peak while someone is smoking: right click the hookah with the jar. Place the jar where you need it and there will be Smoke around it for %s minutes, then the jar turns back empty.

quasium.progression.draft.title: Draft and Pipes
quasium.progression.draft.hint: The distillation cube needs a helper. Distill your first notes.
quasium.progression.draft.page1: Draft is the air that drags smoke through pipes. Generators give it, machines spend it. Everything joined by pipes works as one network: generators fill a shared store, machines take from it evenly. Short on draft, machines slow down but keep going. Every pipe adds %s T to the network's store.
quasium.progression.draft.page2: Your first generator is the bellows. Right click pumps them by hand for %s T/s during one second, and with redstone they pump on their own, %s T/s.
quasium.progression.draft.page3: Pipes come in clay, copper and glass. The weakest pipe sets the limit for the whole network: clay passes 32 T/s, copper 128, glass 256. Notes travel through pipes at 1 ml per second for every 8 T/s.
quasium.progression.draft.page4: The copper pipe is the workhorse for your first machines.
quasium.progression.draft.page5: Glass pipes show the colored smoke of notes.

quasium.progression.golems.title: Golems and Marks
quasium.progression.golems.hint: Golems are forged on the quasium anvil, and marks tell them where to work.
quasium.progression.golems.page1: Golems work for you: the calloud golem tends hookah coals, the clay golem harvests crops and stands guard, the smoke warden shoots mobs. All three are forged on the quasium anvil, and each needs its own kaif. An ownerless golem goes to whoever touches it first, by hand or with the staff.
quasium.progression.golems.page2: Marks tell golems where to work. A mark sits on top of a full block and breaks in one hit, a chunk holds %s of them. A golem works only with the marks you bound it to, with the staff or in the golem window, and sees them within %s blocks. A mark nobody is bound to does nothing by itself. A harvest mark goes in the middle of a field.
quasium.progression.golems.page3: Fill mark: put a chest next to it, the golems bound to it drop their load there and take what they need.
quasium.progression.golems.page4: Guard mark: a clay golem bound to it waits here between jobs and hits hostile mobs within %s blocks around.
quasium.progression.golems.page5: Heat mark: a calloud golem bound to it waits nearby for hookah work.

quasium.progression.hybrids.title: Cross-Breeding
quasium.progression.hybrids.hint: Two ripe bushes of different varieties with a pole between them give a new seed.
quasium.progression.hybrids.page1: A pole cross-breeds tobacco of different varieties. Put it between two ripe bushes on opposite sides: one right next to it, the other next to it or one block further. Two bushes of the same variety do not cross. The pole takes the ripeness from the bushes, they step back one stage, and in 1 to 2 minutes a seed ripens on the pole. Take it with an empty hand.
quasium.progression.hybrids.page2: First the cross checks its luck: a wooden pole succeeds 70%% of the time, reinforced 85%%, golden 95%%, diamond always. A failure takes the ripeness and no seed grows. On a success the hybrid roll comes next: the base chance is 5%%, 8%%, 13%% or 15%% by pole, and every star of the parents' average quality adds %s%% of that chance. Otherwise you get a seed of one parent with its stars.
quasium.progression.hybrids.page3: A hybrid is named after its parents, Dikar x Peschanik for example. Each of its stars is the average of the two bushes plus or minus one, from 1 to 5. A hybrid crossed with a pure variety leans to the hybrid: its stars count twice. Each new hybrid joins your collection at the end of this entry, and the 6 pairs of the four wild varieties are the first generation.
quasium.progression.hybrids.page4: Mutations. A hybrid that inherits none gets a random one with the pole's 5-15%% chance, and parents pass theirs on: if both have one, one carries over 75%% of the time, if only one does, 35%%. Double Yield doubles the leaves per cut and adds a yield star. Fast Growth grows the bush twice as fast. Concentrated adds a strength star, Premium Quality a quality star. Hardy changes nothing yet. The toxic mutation appears on its own in 3%% of hybrids, and from a toxic parent in 50%%: a self-mix from such leaves comes out as poison smoke.
quasium.progression.drying_shelf.page3: Rotten flesh turns into tallow in 20 seconds, you need it for molasses. An undried quasium block dries in 30 seconds.
quasium.progression.fermentation.page4: Fermented leaves go into the soaking bowl. A self-mix also needs an essence pressed from fruit and herbs. The garden entry opens with your first finished leaves.
quasium.progression.garden.title: Garden
quasium.progression.garden.hint: Essences need fruit and herbs, and you can grow them.
quasium.progression.garden.page1: A bonsai pot grows a tiny tree right in your house. Plant a sapling or lavender or cocoa seeds in it, and a fruit ripens in 100 seconds. Pick it with right click and the tree starts over. Sneak right click to dig the sapling back out.
quasium.progression.garden.page2: Lemon tree. Lemon essence gives strength in tobacco, and in the bowl focus it replaces the notes of Smoke Step.
quasium.progression.garden.page3: Lime tree. Lime gives strength in tobacco too.
quasium.progression.garden.page4: Orange tree. Orange gives strength like every citrus.
quasium.progression.garden.page5: Grapefruit tree. Mint together with any citrus in one self-mix gives Speed II.
quasium.progression.garden.page8: Lavender grows in the pot from seeds, one lilac gives two of them. Lavender essence gives regeneration, and together with Nectar it unlocks Waking Dream.
quasium.progression.garden.page9: Cocoa grows in the pot too, cocoa beans give two seeds. Cocoa nibs give resistance.
quasium.progression.garden.page10: Mint and anise grow on farmland like wheat, a ripe plant gives a harvest and a seed. Mint makes you faster in tobacco, and in the bowl focus it replaces the notes of Frost Breath.
quasium.progression.garden.page11: Anise makes you faster in tobacco too, and its aroma in a kaif zone hides you from mobs.
quasium.progression.essence_press.title: Essence Press
quasium.progression.essence_press.hint: Fruit and herbs can be pressed into essence.
quasium.progression.essence_press.page1: The press squeezes out essence. Put in ingredients of one flavor with right click, one at a time, or a whole stack while sneaking. Four of them make 20 ml of essence, collect it with an empty glass bottle. Right click with an empty hand shows what is inside.
quasium.progression.essence_press.page2: Flavors without a garden: mint from ferns, berry from sweet berries, apple, watermelon from slices, cherry from glow berries, vanilla from sugar, coffee from cocoa beans, cinnamon from blaze powder, rose from pink petals, ice from ice, honey from honeycomb, nether flavor from nether wart.
quasium.progression.essence_press.page3: From the garden: lemon, lime, orange, grapefruit, grape, coconut, anise, mint leaves, lavender and cocoa nibs. That makes 21 flavors.
quasium.progression.essence_press.page4: Essence goes into the soaking bowl for a self-mix, into an aroma lamp and into the bowl focus. Note bottles from the distillation cube look the same, but they hold notes, not flavor.
quasium.progression.soaking_bowl.page4: Every essence adds its own effect, and its volume stretches the effects: 20 ml make them last 4 times longer. Mint with a citrus gives Speed II, berry with honey regeneration. Three or more different essences in one bowl give the mix a 50%% chance to turn toxic.
quasium.progression.soaking_bowl.page5: Toxic tobacco comes out as a poison cloud. It hits everyone in front of you except you: the damage is strength x4, at least 1.
quasium.progression.molasses_chain.page4: A bottle of molasses holds 5 ml and goes into the bowl whole, the bowl takes 4 bottles.
quasium.progression.regular_tobacco.page: You have your own taste. Favorite flavors give full kaif, pleasant ones half, the rest nothing, and the ones you hate even take kaif away. A pull teaches you a flavor. An aroma vial is crafted from an empty bottle and two of the flavor's ingredient and sniffed with a right click, but only a connoisseur can tell by the smell how a flavor smokes. Flavors you know go into the list below.
Different flavored tobaccos mix in one bowl: each gram sits in its own slot and the smoke gives every effect by its share. Flavored tobacco and a self-mix don't get along though, see the bowl entry.
quasium.progression.charcoal.page4: 27 mm coal: 1 per briquette, heat 2.0, burns for 8 minutes, space 6. The bigger the coal, the hotter and longer it burns.
quasium.progression.charcoal.page5: A cold coal gives no heat. Heat it in the heater first, then move it into the calloud. Burn time runs out in the heater while it is fired and in the calloud while you pull.
quasium.progression.heater.page3: Without fuel the coals cool down twice as slowly as they heated, so a short break does no harm.
quasium.progression.calloud.page4: Overheat starts when the heat is over 1.8 times the threshold: tobacco burns twice as fast, the hookah spits sparks and the action bar tells you. Take a coal out or use a smaller one. A bowl packed with more than 15 g burns one and a half times faster on top. A full 15 g bowl lasts about 75 plain pulls or 26 spells.
quasium.progression.hookah_bowl.page4: All flavored tobaccos go together. Self-mixes only go together when their leaf is the same variety. Flavored tobacco with a self-mix is incompatible: such a bowl takes kaif away and makes you sick. A bowl that has been in a hookah with tobacco is hot: you cannot add tobacco or change its focus by hand, and an unburned gram you take out is lost. Empty it completely, ash included, and it is fresh again.
quasium.progression.hookah_bowl.page5: Below the tobacco the bowl has three focus slots for note and essence bottles, later you exhale spells from them. The notes entry tells you more.
quasium.progression.hookah.page5: The cooler lowers the heat your tobacco needs by 20%%.
quasium.progression.hookah.page6: The ice chamber turns 25%% of your exhales into frost smoke: it freezes everyone in front of you except you.
quasium.progression.modular_hookah.title: Modular Hookah
quasium.progression.modular_hookah.hint: You can build a hookah yourself from a bulb and a shaft.
quasium.progression.modular_hookah.page1: A modular hookah is built in place. Place a bulb and add water: a bucket fills it to 1000 ml, a bottle adds 250 ml. It draws best at 750 ml, that is three bottles, a full bucket gives 80%% power and no water leaves 40%%. Drain it with an empty bucket.
quasium.progression.modular_hookah.page2: Then sneak and right click with a shaft: it sits on the bulb, and you can't add water after that. The bowl goes on the same way, then the calloud. Screw a diffuser onto the shaft with right click while holding it in either hand.
quasium.progression.modular_hookah.page3: An assembled hookah opens with right click like a regular one and smokes with the same pipe. Shafts come in five colors, bulbs in eight: the jade, violet and gold ones cannot be crafted, they are found in the chests of hookah master huts and abandoned lounges. The color changes nothing. A modular hookah makes a tier two kaif zone right away, even if you smoke alone.
quasium.progression.modular_hookah.page4: A broken modular hookah drops every part: the bulb, the shaft, the bowl, the calloud and the diffuser.
quasium.progression.hookah_minecart.hint: A hookah can ride the rails.
quasium.progression.hookah_minecart.page: A hookah minecart rides the rails.

Right click with a pipe in hand to attach the hose, and its length is unlimited: smoke from the far end of the rails. Sneak right click with an empty hand to unhook. One smoker holds the hose at a time, the rest wait their turn. Right click without a pipe opens the hookah.
Inside are the same slots as in the backpack hookah, and the cart does not make a kaif zone either. Break the cart and it drops the minecart, the hookah and everything that was inside.
advancements.quasium.kaif_level_20.title: Warm
advancements.quasium.smokecraft.overdose: Smoke too much tobacco in a short time
quasium.progression.kaif_system.page4: Kaif opens up the mod: at 10 kaif quasium ore gives pieces, at %s the kaifometer hears the notes of items, at %s the notes of mobs. The anvil asks for its own kaif level per recipe, and at 20 rank bonuses begin.
quasium.progression.kaif_ranks.title: Kaif Ranks
quasium.progression.kaif_ranks.hint: The higher your kaif, the more it gives.
quasium.progression.kaif_ranks.page1: Kaif has ten ranks. From -100 to -81 ROCK BOTTOM, up to -51 Severe Withdrawal, up to -21 Withdrawal, up to -1 Sober. Then every 20: Relaxed from 0, Warm from 20, Flight from 40, Trance from 60, Euphoria from 80 and MAX at exactly 100.
quasium.progression.kaif_ranks.page2: High kaif brings bonuses: haste at 20, night vision at 40, regeneration at 60, resistance at 80. The effect is given the moment kaif crosses the threshold and lasts 30 seconds. Drop below the threshold and the bonus is gone.
quasium.progression.kaif_ranks.page3: Pulls are not the only source: every spell gives %s, a kill with a spell %s, and trick rings in a combo give %s each from the third one. Well dried jerky gives kaif too.
quasium.progression.overdose.title: Overdose
quasium.progression.overdose.hint: Smoke too much and you will find out.
quasium.progression.overdose.page1: An overdose is too much: it comes when within %s minutes you burn %s g of tobacco or more, counting pulls and the tobacco burnt by spells alike. It hits at once: kaif drops by half, you feel sick, your sight darkens, your arms go weak.
quasium.progression.overdose.page2: Until the extra grams fall out of the %s minute window the world plays tricks: see-through mobs that are not there flicker nearby, you hear sounds nobody made, and kaif drains away, even below zero. Only time without tobacco cures it. After death the count starts over.
quasium.progression.lounge.title: Lounge
quasium.progression.lounge.page1: Sit on a lounge cushion by right clicking it with an empty hand. While seated, kaif melts at %s%% of the normal speed.
quasium.progression.lounge.page2: A low table holds up to 4 items: put them on with right click, take them off with an empty hand.
quasium.progression.lounge.page3: An aroma lamp runs on essence: pour in up to %s ml of one flavor and light it with flint and steel. One ml burns for %s seconds, and everyone within %s blocks gets the flavor's aroma, like in a tier two kaif zone. Sneak right click with an empty hand to put it out.
quasium.progression.lounge.page4: Aromas: mint gives haste, coffee night vision, ice fire resistance, nether flavor strength but spells burn 20%% more tobacco, anise hides you from mobs, lavender softens falls and keeps phantoms away, berry and watermelon keep you fed. Other flavors have no aroma.
quasium.progression.lounge.page5: Glowing bulbs give light level 12 and come in five colors. Lounge furniture counts for Nirvana: at least %s pieces near the hookah.
quasium.progression.smelting_quasium.pag: Nine ingots make an undried quasium block. Put it on a drying shelf: in 30 seconds it becomes a quasium block, and the anvil is built from those blocks.
quasium.progression.quasium_anvil.page4: The backpack hookah is worn on your back.
quasium.progression.quasium_anvil.page5: Golems, their modules and the smoke warden are forged here too, see the Golems section.
quasium.progression.notes_first_exhale.p: First spells. Frost Breath: two Menthol and a Dew, or a mint essence. Ember Breath: Ember and Ash, or a coffee essence. Smoke Screen: Ash and Dew. Sprout: Nectar, Resin and Dew. Whisper of Coals: Ember and Menthol, it lights up ores around you. The other spells open after your first exhale.
quasium.progression.spells.title: Spells
quasium.progression.spells.hint: Exhale your first spell to learn the rest.
quasium.progression.spells.page1: A spell has a form. A beam flies straight, a cone sweeps in front of you, a cloud flies ahead and hangs in place, a ring triggers where it stops, a pulse spreads out from you. Every spell has its own cost in smoke and tobacco and its own cooldown.
quasium.progression.spells.page2: Frost Breath hits in a 5 block cone: 2 damage, Slowness III for 4 seconds and freezing, double damage to fire mobs. Ember Breath flies as a 24 block beam: 3 damage and 4 seconds of fire, and where fire can't spread the ground catches fire.
quasium.progression.spells.page3: Smoke Screen, Ash and Dew: a cloud for 10 seconds, mobs inside go blind and lose their target, and nobody sees you in it. Heavy Smoke, Resin and Ash: a cloud for 6 seconds, enemies in it bog down and grow heavy, fall damage %s%%.
quasium.progression.spells.page4: Healing Steam, Nectar and Dew or a vanilla essence: a cloud for 8 seconds gives regeneration to everyone inside except the undead, you included. Sprout, Nectar, Resin and Dew: a cone that hurries crops and saplings in front of you.
quasium.progression.spells.page5: Waking Dream, lavender and Nectar: a cone that puts mobs to sleep for 8 seconds, they drop their target and freeze, a player is only slowed. Whisper of Coals, Ember and Menthol: a pulse that lights up ores within 16 blocks for 10 seconds, and only you see them. Ring spells are in the rings entry.
quasium.progression.mixing_table.title: Mixing Table
quasium.progression.mixing_table.hint: The bowl focus can be upgraded.
quasium.progression.mixing_table.page1: The mixing table works with a hookah bowl. Put the bowl in the bottom slot and its three focus slots and the upgrade slot open next to it: a handy way to charge the focus without opening the bowl. A hot bowl can change its focus only here, its tobacco stays. The table tells you when the notes in the focus don't add up to a spell.
quasium.progression.mixing_table.page2: An upgrade is made in the top row from 20 ml of a note and a catalyst. A bowl holds one upgrade.
quasium.progression.mixing_table.page3: Resonator, Menthol and redstone: the spell catches one more target at %s%% power. Collimator, Resin and an amethyst shard: range %s%%, width %s%%. Cooler, Dew and ice: a cast burns %s%% less tobacco.
quasium.progression.mixing_table.page4: Splitter, Ember and quartz: the spell flies as three charges in a fan, each at %s%% power. Condenser, Nectar and glass: your lungs hold %s ml more. Filter, Ash and paper: casts don't add smoke density.
quasium.progression.draft.page6: Click a pipe with the kaifometer to see the whole network: draft given and asked for, how much arrives, the bottleneck, which notes travel and what is connected.
quasium.progression.draft.page7: Smoke valve: redstone closes it and cuts the network in two.
quasium.progression.draft.page10: Smoke splitter: jars and machines around it get an equal share of smoke.
quasium.progression.machines.title: Machines
quasium.progression.machines.hint: Draft drives machines. Pump the bellows to open them.
quasium.progression.machines.page2: Put the flask charger next to a hookah. It stores charges, up to %s, one every %s seconds at full draft, %s T/s. A charge gives a cast without a pull and without tobacco, but the focus spends %s times more essence.
quasium.progression.machines.page4: Put the pneumatic hammer over a quasium anvil and it strikes by itself: one hit every %s ticks at full draft, %s T/s. The recipe's kaif is taken from whoever placed the hammer.
quasium.progression.calloud_golem.title: Calloud Golem
quasium.progression.calloud_golem.hint: A golem made from a calloud adds coals by itself.
quasium.progression.calloud_golem.page1: The calloud golem is forged on the anvil. It has %s health and is not afraid of fire. Right click it with calloud coal, 22, 25 or 27 mm, to give it up to %s pieces.
quasium.progression.calloud_golem.page2: Every 2 seconds the golem checks hookahs within %s blocks: where the heat dropped below %s%% it adds a burning coal, and if the calloud is full it relights the coldest one for free.
quasium.progression.calloud_golem.page3: When idle, the golem stays within 8 blocks of its heat mark, without one it keeps to the spot where you placed it. Out of coal, it walks to its fill mark and takes calloud coal from the chest next to it, leaving everything else. It hits any mob that goes for the golem or for you inside that circle: 1 damage and %s seconds of fire.
quasium.progression.clay_golem.title: Clay Golem
quasium.progression.clay_golem.hint: A clay golem reaps crops and carries them to storage.
quasium.progression.clay_golem.page1: The clay golem is forged on the anvil. It has %s health and carries %s stacks. Put a harvest mark in the middle of a field: the golem reaps ripe crops in a 9x9 square around it, replants on farmland and picks up whatever lies nearby. Tobacco gets sheared and the plant keeps growing.
quasium.progression.clay_golem.page2: When full or out of work, the golem carries the load to the chest at its fill mark, and between jobs it waits at its guard mark. A tool in its hand gives it a job inside a zone mark, see the Golem Jobs article.
quasium.progression.clay_golem.page3: You can pour two notes into a clay golem: right click it with a bottle, %s ml make one charge. Every harvest trip and every drop-off takes %s ml from each slot. Menthol makes it %s%% faster, Nectar adds %s more stacks, Resin adds %s health, Ash burns rotten flesh, poisonous potatoes and dead bushes instead of hauling them. The golem takes Dew too, but it does nothing for it yet. The poured notes show up in the golem window when you hover over its figure.
quasium.progression.clay_golem.page4: Sommelier Module: use it on a clay golem and it will take tobacco before anything else, and the freshly ripened bushes first. That way the leaves keep their timing star. A broken golem drops the module back.
quasium.progression.golem_care.title: Golem Care
quasium.progression.golem_care.hint: A golem needs care: food and a pat.
quasium.progression.golem_care.page1: Golems need looking after. Calloud and clay golems have four states, each with its own face, and the state sets the ceiling: happy works at 100%%, calm at 80%%, sad at 60%%, exhausted slides from 40%% down to 1%% along with the meter. Below 25%% of the meter work slides down to half the ceiling, and on an empty meter the golem drops its work and goes to eat. At 10%% and below it keeps falling over, at 1%% it lies down and barely crawls. The lower the number, the slower it walks and works.
quasium.progression.golem_care.page2: The meter lives inside a state. A full one melts in %s minutes of idling, and every job eats another %s%% on top. An empty meter is a miss, and while it stays empty another one comes every quarter of that time. 4 misses drop the golem one state. Feeding it before the meter runs dry is on time: 4 on-time meals in a row, at most one per quarter of that time, lift it one state. A miss breaks the streak, an on-time meal clears the misses.
quasium.progression.golem_care.page3: Golems eat apples and French fries. A plain apple or a serving of fries gives %s%% of the meter. A golden one fills the meter to the brim and lifts the golem one state, a happy one just gets the full meter. An enchanted golden apple makes it happy and full at once. Shift+right-click with food feeds it, but when more than 80%% would go to waste the golem refuses and says how much, then Ctrl+Shift+right-click feeds it anyway.
quasium.progression.golem_care.page4: Shift+right-click with an empty hand pets the golem: %s%% of the meter and some hearts, then %s seconds of waiting. Right-click opens the golem window with the Care, Marks, Journal and Work tabs. Care shows its figure with the current face, the meter in the state colour, how hard it works, misses, the streak, a food stash and a pet button. The golem eats from the stash by itself once the meter drops below 25%%, and that counts as on time. The first right-click makes an ownerless golem yours, someone else's window won't open.
quasium.progression.golem_care.page5: In a kaif zone by a smoking hookah or a smoke jar the golem dances: bounces, waves its arms, notes pop over its head. Work goes on as usual, and the meter doesn't drain inside the zone. A calloud golem by a hookah people smoke at hardly ever goes hungry.
quasium.progression.golem_staff.title: Golem Staff
quasium.progression.golem_staff.hint: A golem works only with the marks bound to it.
quasium.progression.golem_staff.page1: Right-click your golem with the staff to pick it, then right-click a mark to bind the golem there, a second click unbinds it. A clay golem binds to harvest, fill, guard and zone marks and to a program table, a calloud golem to heat and fill marks. The Marks tab of the golem window does the same.
quasium.progression.golem_staff.page2: A golem works only with the marks it is bound to and leaves unbound ones alone. One golem can hold any number of marks, and one mark can serve several golems. A mark remembers who placed it, only the owner of both the mark and the golem can change bindings. When a golem dies, its bindings are removed.
quasium.progression.golem_staff.page3: Shift+right-click a fill mark with the staff to pick it, then right-click a chest or barrel within %s blocks to make it the mark's storage, up to %s of them. Such a mark stores and hands out only through its storages, without any the blocks around it work as before. Shift+right-click a zone mark and right-click the second corner to size the zone. Place a mark with the staff in your other hand and it is bound to the picked golem right away. Shift+right-click the air clears the pick, and while the staff is in hand bindings show up as faint dots.
quasium.progression.smoke_warden.title: Smoke Warden
quasium.progression.smoke_warden.hint: A smoke warden guards your home from mobs.
quasium.progression.smoke_warden.page1: First you need a warden blank.
quasium.progression.smoke_warden.page2: On the anvil the blank gets a full bottle of Ash. The warden stays where you place it, has %s health, and a clay ball repairs %s. It burns coal or charcoal, up to %s pieces, one per %s shots. A broken warden drops its blank and its coal.
quasium.progression.smoke_warden.page3: Every %s ticks the warden fires smoke at a hostile mob within %s blocks, creepers first: %s damage, %s seconds of poison and %s seconds of Slowness II. Undead and spiders ignore the poison, not the slowness. Shots fly through friends and peaceful mobs. Put the warden behind a fence: zombies can't reach it and the shots go over the top.
quasium.progression.warden_friends.title: Warden Owner and Friends
quasium.progression.warden_friends.hint: A warden listens only to its owner and friends.
quasium.progression.warden_friends.page1: Whoever places the warden owns it and stays its friend. Only the owner adds friends: rename a paper on an anvil to a player's name and right click the warden with it, sneak to cross the name out with the same paper. The paper is not used up and works for every warden. It never shoots friends and only shoots other players after they hit it, its owner or a friend nearby.
quasium.progression.warden_friends.page2: Right click with an empty hand to see whose warden it is and how much coal and health it has, the owner also gets the friend list. The owner picks the warden up by sneaking and right clicking with an empty hand: coal, friends and health stay in the item.
quasium.hint.tobacco_crops.title: Tobacco: planting and crossbreeding
quasium.hint.tobacco_crops.1: Tobacco seeds go only on farmland: till the ground with a hoe and right-click it with the seeds.
quasium.hint.tobacco_crops.2: Water a bush from a water bucket: a watered bush grows faster.
quasium.hint.tobacco_crops.3: Shear a ripe bush: leaves drop out and the bush grows back on its own.
quasium.hint.tobacco_crops.4: Put a tobacco pole between two ripe bushes of different varieties: crossbreeding starts and takes 1-2 minutes. The same variety does not cross.
quasium.hint.tobacco_crops.5: Pole luck: wooden 70%%, reinforced 85%%, golden 95%%, diamond always. On a success a seed grows above it: a hybrid with a 5-15%% chance by pole, higher with good parents, otherwise a seed of one parent. Take it with right-click.
quasium.hint.fermentation.title: Fermenting leaves
quasium.hint.fermentation.1: Place a fermentation barrel. It only takes dried leaves: dry fresh ones on a drying shelf first.
quasium.hint.fermentation.2: Right-click with a stack of dried leaves to load up to 16 of one kind.
quasium.hint.fermentation.3: Sugar before the start cuts 10 seconds each, but every portion adds a 15%% risk to spoil the batch. The barrel takes 3 at most.
quasium.hint.fermentation.4: Start the barrel with an empty-hand right-click or a right-click with the netherite hammer. Fermenting takes 60 seconds.
quasium.hint.fermentation.5: When the barrel goes quiet, take the leaves with an empty hand. Fermented leaves go into the soaking bowl.
quasium.hint.drying_shelf.title: Drying shelf
quasium.hint.drying_shelf.1: A drying shelf hangs on a wall: place it on the side of a solid block.
quasium.hint.drying_shelf.2: Right-click puts one item on the shelf: a tobacco leaf, raw meat, fish or rotten flesh.
quasium.hint.drying_shelf.3: A leaf dries to 100%% in 60 seconds. Past 140%% it is overdried, and an overdried leaf makes a stronger mix.
quasium.hint.drying_shelf.4: Rotten flesh turns into tallow in 20 seconds, an undried quasium block dries in 30 seconds.
quasium.hint.drying_shelf.5: Meat and fish turn into jerky and keep drying up to 150%%. Under 70%% jerky takes kaif, drier jerky gives it, up to 15 at 150%%.
quasium.hint.molasses.title: Tallow, glycerin and molasses
quasium.hint.molasses.1: Tallow comes from rotten flesh: leave it on a drying shelf for 20 seconds.
quasium.hint.molasses.2: In a brewing stand put bottled ghast acid in the bottom slots, tallow on top and blaze powder as fuel.
quasium.hint.molasses.3: In 20 seconds the acid turns into glycerin.
quasium.hint.molasses.4: Glycerin becomes molasses at a crafting table. The recipe opens in the book.
quasium.hint.molasses.5: Right-click the soaking bowl with molasses to add 5 ml, up to 20 ml. More molasses means a milder mix.
quasium.hint.essence_press.title: Essence Press
quasium.hint.essence_press.1: Place an essence press. It squeezes fruit, berries, herbs and other fragrant things.
quasium.hint.essence_press.2: Load 4 of one flavor: right-click adds one, Shift+right-click adds the stack.
quasium.hint.essence_press.3: Once it holds 4, the press makes 20 ml of essence. Right-click with an empty bottle to fill it.
quasium.hint.essence_press.4: Fruit, lavender and cocoa grow in a bonsai pot: right-click a sapling or seeds to plant, right-click the grown plant to pick it. Mint and anise grow on farmland.
quasium.hint.essence_press.5: Essence goes into the soaking bowl: it gives a self-mix its flavor and effect.
quasium.hint.soaking_bowl.title: Self-mix in the soaking bowl
quasium.hint.soaking_bowl.1: Place a soaking bowl and put 1 fermented leaf into it.
quasium.hint.soaking_bowl.2: Right-click with essence to pour 5 ml of flavor, with molasses for 5 ml of mildness. Each liquid takes up to 20 ml.
quasium.hint.soaking_bowl.3: Stir with a stick to start the mix: it takes 30 seconds, and every extra stir cuts 5 seconds.
quasium.hint.soaking_bowl.4: Three or more different essences can make the mix toxic. Right-click with an empty hand to check the bowl.
quasium.hint.soaking_bowl.5: Done: take the mix with an empty bowl. You get a 30 g pack of self-mix.
quasium.hint.hookah_coals.title: Coals, heater and calloud
quasium.hint.hookah_coals.1: Coals come in 22, 25 and 27 mm. The bigger the coal, the hotter it gets and the longer it burns: 3, 5 and 8 minutes.
quasium.hint.hookah_coals.2: Place a heater. The slot on the right takes charcoal as fuel, the 15 cells on the left take your hookah coals.
quasium.hint.hookah_coals.3: While fuel burns, coals heat up to 100%% three times faster than they burn. Without fuel they cool down.
quasium.hint.hookah_coals.4: Right-click with a calloud to open it. It has room for 12: a 22 mm coal takes 3, 25 mm takes 4, 27 mm takes 6. The upper tier sits on the lower one.
quasium.hint.hookah_coals.5: A calloud with hot coals goes into the hookah. Watch the heat bar in the hookah window: the green part is the working heat for this tobacco, in the red part tobacco burns twice as fast.
quasium.hint.hookah_setup.title: Setting up a hookah
quasium.hint.hookah_setup.1: Place a hookah. Right-click it to open slots for the calloud, the bowl and accessories.
quasium.hint.hookah_setup.2: Fill the bowl: right-click it in hand and spread tobacco over the cells, 1 cell = 1 g, 20 g in all. Right-click a tobacco pack to take 1 g out.
quasium.hint.hookah_setup.3: Put the bowl and a calloud with hot coals into the hookah. A diffuser, a cooler and an ice chamber go into the accessory slots.
quasium.hint.hookah_setup.4: Take the pipe and right-click the hookah: the hose attaches to you.
quasium.hint.hookah_setup.5: Hold right-click with the pipe to draw and release to exhale. The smoke gives kaif. Shift+right-click with an empty hand unhooks the hose.
quasium.hint.hookah_setup.6: A fresh bowl takes 10 pulls to warm up. The hookah puffs smoke, bubbles and says it is at its peak: now it draws at full strength. The window shows the stage under the bars.
quasium.hint.modular_hookah.title: Modular hookah
quasium.hint.modular_hookah.1: Place a modular hookah bulb and fill it: a bucket fills it to 1000 ml, a water bottle adds 250 ml. It draws best at 750 ml.
quasium.hint.modular_hookah.2: Shift+right-click with a shaft to mount it. Water cannot go in once the shaft is on, so water first.
quasium.hint.modular_hookah.3: A diffuser screws onto the shaft: hold it in either hand and right-click the hookah.
quasium.hint.modular_hookah.4: Shift+right-click with the bowl to set it, then Shift+right-click with a calloud of hot coals.
quasium.hint.modular_hookah.5: The finished hookah smokes like a regular one, and it gives a tier II kaif zone even to a single smoker.
quasium.hint.quasium_anvil.title: Quasium anvil
quasium.hint.quasium_anvil.1: Place the quasium anvil. Like a regular anvil, it falls if nothing is under it.
quasium.hint.quasium_anvil.2: Put items on it with right-click, up to 3 different ones. Order matters. An item like the last one stacks onto it. An empty-hand right-click takes the last stack back.
quasium.hint.quasium_anvil.3: Strike the anvil with the netherite hammer. Every recipe needs its own number of hits.
quasium.hint.quasium_anvil.4: A recipe also needs your kaif. If you are short, the anvil tells you how much: smoke a little and come back.
quasium.hint.quasium_anvil.5: After the last hit the item drops into your inventory. A pneumatic hammer above the anvil strikes by itself when it gets draft.
quasium.hint.distillation.title: Notes and the distillation cube
quasium.hint.distillation.1: The kaifometer reads notes: right-click a block or a mob with it, or hold an item in the other hand. Items need %s kaif, mobs %s.
quasium.hint.distillation.2: Place a distillation cube and pour in water with a bucket or bottles. Each item uses %s ml, the cube holds %s ml.
quasium.hint.distillation.3: In the cube window put an item with notes in the top slot and fuel in the bottom one: the cube breaks it into notes.
quasium.hint.distillation.4: Notes collect in 6 gauges of %s ml. Click a gauge with an empty bottle to fill up to %s ml of that note.
quasium.hint.distillation.5: A note jar holds %s ml of one note: right-click with a bottle to pour it in, with an empty bottle to fill one.
quasium.hint.casting.title: Casting from the hookah
quasium.hint.casting.1: A hookah bowl is a focus: its window has 3 cells for note bottles. The mix of notes decides the spell.
quasium.hint.casting.2: Hook up the pipe and hold right-click: your lungs fill with smoke, they hold %s ml.
quasium.hint.casting.3: Once you hold enough smoke, release right-click: the exhale becomes the spell. It uses tobacco from the bowl and %s ml of notes.
quasium.hint.casting.4: The longer you hold the smoke, the stronger the spell, but after %s s you cough: the smoke is lost and kaif drops.
quasium.hint.casting.5: Inside a kaif zone spells cost less, and in a tier II zone you hold smoke without coughing.
quasium.hint.smoke_rings.title: Smoke rings
quasium.hint.smoke_rings.1: Rings are blown with a pipe from a hookah. For a trick ring draw for at least a second while the hookah is at its peak.
quasium.hint.smoke_rings.2: Hold Shift while drawing: a bar with a moving marker appears above the hotbar.
quasium.hint.smoke_rings.3: Release right-click while the marker is in the green zone. The yellow middle gives a perfect ring.
quasium.hint.smoke_rings.4: Blow rings in a row less than %s s apart: from the third ring on, each gives %s kaif.
quasium.hint.smoke_rings.5: With a ring spell in the bowl, the ring releases it, and a perfect ring hits at %s%% power.
quasium.hint.kaif_zones.title: Kaif zones and the lounge
quasium.hint.kaif_zones.1: While you smoke a hookah, a kaif zone surrounds it. One smoker makes a tier I zone, radius %s.
quasium.hint.kaif_zones.2: Two smokers or a modular hookah make a tier II zone, radius %s. In it you hold smoke without coughing.
quasium.hint.kaif_zones.3: Three smokers plus lounge furniture nearby, %s pieces or more, make nirvana, radius %s.
quasium.hint.kaif_zones.4: In a zone spells cost %s%% less, kaif grows %s%% more, mobs see you %s%% worse and phantoms stay away.
quasium.hint.kaif_zones.5: Right-click a hookah at its peak with an empty smoke jar to bottle the smoke. A placed jar keeps a tier I zone for %s min.
quasium.hint.kaif_zones.6: The lo-fi kaif beats disc playing in a jukebox nearby widens the zone by %s.
quasium.hint.mixing_table.title: Mixing table
quasium.hint.mixing_table.1: Place a mixing table. It makes focus upgrades and sets up a bowl focus.
quasium.hint.mixing_table.2: Put in a note bottle and a catalyst: a focus upgrade appears in the result slot.
quasium.hint.mixing_table.3: Put a hookah bowl in its slot: an upgrade cell and 3 focus note cells open.
quasium.hint.mixing_table.4: Insert an upgrade and note bottles. Notes decide the spell, the upgrade changes its range, power or cost.
quasium.hint.mixing_table.5: Take the bowl: the focus stays in it and works in any hookah. A hot bowl can change its focus only here, its tobacco stays.
quasium.hint.draft_network.title: Draft and pipes
quasium.hint.draft_network.1: Draft pulls smoke through pipes. The first generator is the bellows: right-click pumps them by hand, a redstone signal pumps them on its own.
quasium.hint.draft_network.2: Connect generators, note jars and machines with pipes. Everything connected is one network: generators give draft, machines take it.
quasium.hint.draft_network.3: The weakest pipe sets the cap for the whole network. By strength: clay, copper, glass.
quasium.hint.draft_network.4: A valve closes under a redstone signal and splits the network in two.
quasium.hint.draft_network.5: A smoke splitter shares smoke evenly between the jars and machines around it. A glass pipe shows which notes flow.
quasium.hint.draft_network.6: Click a pipe with the kaifometer: it shows the network draft, the bottleneck and which notes flow.
quasium.hint.draft_machines.title: Draft machines
quasium.hint.draft_machines.1: The bellows push draft through the pipes. A flask charger next to a hookah stores charges: a charge gives a spell without a pull or tobacco.
quasium.hint.draft_machines.2: A pneumatic hammer above a quasium anvil strikes by itself. It takes the kaif for the recipe from whoever placed it.
quasium.hint.golems.title: Golems, marks and the staff
quasium.hint.golems.1: Golems are made on the quasium anvil. Right-click the ground with a golem figure to place it, and it is yours.
quasium.hint.golems.2: A calloud golem keeps hookahs around it hot, radius %s. Feed it hookah coals: right-click the golem with a coal.
quasium.hint.golems.3: Marks tell golems where to work, but a golem only takes the ones bound to it. At a harvest mark the clay golem picks ripe crops in a 9x9 square.
quasium.hint.golems.4: At a fill mark the golem drops its harvest into a chest next to it, and the calloud golem takes coal from there.
quasium.hint.golems.5: A guard mark: the clay golem bound to it hits hostile mobs around it. A heat mark keeps the calloud golem close by.
quasium.hint.golems.6: Staff: right-click your golem, then a mark to bind it there. Shift+right-click a fill mark, then right-click containers to make them its storage.
quasium.hint.golems.7: Right-click a golem with an empty hand to open its window: care with a food stash, marks, a journal and work. Golems eat apples, Shift+right-click with an empty hand pets one.
quasium.hint.smoke_warden.title: Smoke warden
quasium.hint.smoke_warden.1: The smoke warden is a turret. It is made on the quasium anvil, placed with right-click on the ground and obeys only its owner.
quasium.hint.smoke_warden.2: Feed it coal or charcoal: right-click the warden. It holds %s, and one coal gives %s shots.
quasium.hint.smoke_warden.3: The warden shoots hostile mobs, range %s: poison for %s s and slowness for %s s.
quasium.hint.smoke_warden.4: Fence the warden in: mobs cannot reach the turret while it shoots.
quasium.hint.smoke_warden.5: A clay ball repairs the warden by %s health. Paper renamed at an anvil to a player name adds a friend, Shift+right-click with it removes one.
quasium.hint.smoke_warden.6: Right-click with an empty hand shows fuel and health. The owner picks the warden up with Shift+right-click and an empty hand.
quasium.hint.smoke_kiln.title: Smoke kiln and infusions
quasium.hint.smoke_kiln.1: The smoke kiln infuses tools and weapons with notes. Place it and open it with right-click.
quasium.hint.smoke_kiln.2: Put in up to 4 items with durability and a note bottle.
quasium.hint.smoke_kiln.3: Each item drinks %s ml of the note and smokes for %s s. Then the kiln moves on to the next one.
quasium.hint.smoke_kiln.4: Ember: hits set on fire and mining sometimes drops an ember chunk. Resin: durability +%s%%. Dew: shears and fishing rods bring more.
quasium.hint.smoke_kiln.5: Menthol: a pickaxe mines ice and snow whole. Nectar: a hoe harvests and replants 3x3. Ash: a finishing blow burns the body and gives Ash.
quasium.hint.smoke_kiln.6: Take finished items out of the window. Their tooltip shows the infusion.
quasium.progression.lounge.page6: The lounge has its own disc, Lo-Fi Kaif Beats. Play it in a jukebox next to the hookah and the kaif zone grows by %s blocks. The button at the end of this article gives the first disc for free, every next one costs insight: %s.

quasium.progression.golem_staff.page4: The Marks tab of the golem window shows the marks it is bound to: the mark icon, coordinates and how many blocks away it is. The minus button unbinds. A program table it sees twice as far.
quasium.progression.clay_golem.page5: Bound to a guard mark, the golem hits hostile mobs within %s blocks of it: %s damage every %s ticks, a sad one hits slower. Without a guard mark it doesn't fight.
advancements.quasium.first_tobacco.title: First Tobacco
advancements.quasium.first_tobacco.descr: Get any tobacco: flavored or a self-mix
quasium.progression.hookah.pipe: The pipe is crafted too: 2 leather and an iron nugget. Every hookah needs a pipe.
quasium.hookah.peak: The hookah is warmed up: full strength, smoke at its peak
quasium.hookah.tail: %s g or less left, the hookah is burning out: pulls get weaker
quasium.hookah.overheat: Overheating: tobacco burns twice as fast, take a coal out
quasium.gui.hookah.heat_over: Above the green band it overheats: tobacco burns twice as fast

quasium.scan.hookah.next_cold: A zone gathers once the hookah draws: it needs tobacco and heat

quasium.scan.hookah.next_haze: For Haze: one more smoker or a modular hookah
quasium.scan.hookah.next_nirvana: For Nirvana: %s of %s smoking, %s of %s lounge pieces
quasium.scan.hookah.next_max: Nirvana, as high as it goes
quasium.progression.kaif_zones.page5: Not sure why there is no zone? Right click the hookah with a kaifometer: it tells the heat and the stage, which zone stands and how many people smoke, and what the next zone needs. Step into a zone and its name flashes above the hotbar.
quasium.hint.hookah_setup.7: The backpack hookah and the hookah minecart work the same way: a bowl, a calloud with coals and the pipe.
quasium.hint.kaif_zones.7: The disc plays in layers: keys always, bass in a tier I zone, drums in tier II, the melody in nirvana. Outside a zone you hear only the keys.
quasium.tooltip.aroma_vial: Right-click: sniff it. A connoisseur can tell by the smell whether the flavor suits them

quasium.progression.golem_care.feeder: The golem feeder is a trough with 9 slots. It takes only apples, golden and enchanted ones, by hand with right-click or through a hopper. While there is food inside, apples show in the trough. The feeder works like a mark: bind a golem to it with the staff or on the Marks tab, both golems can use it. Break the feeder and the food drops.
quasium.progression.golem_care.meals: A bound golem walks to its feeder every evening after sunset and right away once the meter drops below 25%%, even with an empty meter. It eats from its own stash in the window first and goes to the shared feeder when that is empty. It eats one item a second: a plain apple while it fits without waste, a golden one if the golem is not happy, an enchanted one if it is sad or exhausted. Full to 75%% or out of anything to eat, it goes back to work.
quasium.progression.golem_care.queue: Only one golem eats at a feeder, the others wait within 3 blocks and take turns. If the eater gets stuck or walks off, the spot frees up after 3 seconds. At an empty feeder the golem notes it in the journal and goes back to work, a hungry one checks again a minute later.
quasium.progression.calloud_golem.refill: The calloud golem also refills the bowls of the same hookahs. It fills an empty bowl on its own, and the Refill now button on the Work tab tops every bowl below 15 g up to 15 g. It takes tobacco from the storage of its fill mark: packs, self-mix or single grams, one kind at a time, never flavored and self-mix together. The ash from the bowl goes back to the storage, and after a refill the hookah warms up again. The Refill button pauses this and turns it back on. With no tobacco in storage the golem notes it in the journal and tries later.
quasium.progression.golem_staff.feeder: The staff binds a golem feeder just like a mark: right-click your golem, then right-click the feeder. Clay and calloud golems both fit, and one feeder can take any number of golems. Without the staff, right-click opens the feeder slots.

quasium.progression.golem_jobs.title: Golem Jobs
quasium.progression.golem_jobs.hint: A tool in hand gives a golem its job, a zone mark shows where to work.
quasium.progression.golem_jobs.page1: A zone mark outlines a work area. Place it, shift+right-click it with the staff, then right-click the opposite corner: you get a box up to 32x16x32 blocks. Without a second corner the zone is 9x3x9 around the mark. While the staff is in hand, the borders show as dots. A zone mark binds to a golem like any other mark.
quasium.progression.golem_jobs.page2: A tool in the clay golem's hand decides what it does in the zone: an axe makes it a lumberjack, a sword a herder, shears a shearer, a fishing rod a fisher. A tool from another mod works too if it can do the same. With no tool or any other tool it is a tobacco hand. Right-click the golem with a tool or put it in the slot on the Work tab. Every log, hit, shearing and catch costs the tool one durability point, and once it breaks the golem turns into a tobacco hand. Harvest marks work as before, with a tool or without. While a golem runs a program table, its job, harvest marks, unloading at storage, guarding and tool swaps all wait.
quasium.progression.golem_jobs.page3: A lumberjack looks for a log standing on dirt in the zone whose tree has leaves. It walks up to the trunk and fells the whole tree from the top down, up to 64 logs, one per swing, the logs go into its load. Then it picks up saplings, sticks and apples in the zone and plants a sapling where the stump was, if the spot is free.
quasium.progression.golem_jobs.page4: A herder counts every kind of animal in the zone, babies included. When a herd is over the limit, it culls surplus adults one at a time with the sword in its hand, the drops go into its load. It never touches babies, named or leashed animals, pets or horses. When a herd is under the limit, it feeds two adults their food from its load, and fetches food from storage when it has none. The - and + buttons on the Work tab set the limit, from 2 to 32.
quasium.progression.golem_jobs.page5: A shearer shears every woolly sheep in the zone, the wool goes into its load. A fisher stands on the shore of open water in its zone, casts the rod and waits for a bite like a player, and the catch goes into its load. A golem fishes up no treasure, only fish and junk. A rod with Lure brings bites sooner, with Luck of the Sea less junk.
quasium.progression.golem_jobs.page6: A tobacco hand reaps ripe crops and tobacco in the zone, the same way as at a harvest mark. It lays fresh leaves from its load or storage on empty drying shelves, takes them off dry before they overdry, puts them into fermentation barrels and starts them, and takes out what is done. Into a self-mix bowl it puts a fermented leaf and one bottle of molasses or essence, stirs and takes the finished self-mix. A tobacco hand dries only on a shelf inside its zone mark: with a harvest mark alone the leaves go to storage raw, and the golem says so in its journal. It skips any step whose blocks are not in the zone and carries everything else to storage.
quasium.progression.golem_jobs.page7: Toolkeeper module: right-click a clay golem with it. When its tool is down to 10%% durability, the golem takes it to storage, leaves it there and picks up a fresh tool of the same job. With no fresh tool it works as a tobacco hand, and the old tool stays intact. With nowhere to put the old one, the golem stands holding it and tells its owner in chat. Without the module the tool breaks on the job. A broken golem drops the module back.

The tooltip shows the percent, take it off any time.

quasium.hint.mobile_hookahs.5: Inside, both smoke like a normal hookah: the same warm-up, heat and overheat. A broken cart drops itself, the hookah and everything in it.

quasium.hint.quasium_ore.2: The ore gives raw quasium only if you have at least 10 kaif. With less it breaks for nothing.
quasium.hint.quasium_ore.3: The higher your kaif, the more it gives: up to 39 kaif 1 piece, from 40 up to 2, from 70 up to 3, at 100 up to 4. Fortune on the pickaxe does not help.
quasium.hint.quasium_ore.4: Silk touch takes the ore as a block. Break it later, when you have more kaif.
quasium.hint.quasium_ore.5: Raw quasium smelts into an ingot, twice as fast in a blast furnace. Nine ingots make an undried block, and a drying shelf turns it into a block for the anvil in 30 seconds.

quasium.progression.golems.paths: Golems never wade into water and walk around it, and they step up one block on their own, so stairs and farmland edges are no trouble. Paths are searched within 16 blocks, so a golem cannot walk around a long canal.

quasium.progression.smog.page3: If density stays at %s for %s minutes in a row, smog grows by 1 and the density drops to %s. Smog runs from 1 to 5. quasium.research.research_notes_kiln.pag: The kiln infuses tools and weapons with notes. On the left is the slot for a note bottle, on the right four slots for items with durability. A bottle, %s ml, infuses one item in %s seconds. While working the kiln smolders and smokes. A new infusion replaces the old one and keeps the wear the item already had.
quasium.research.research_draft_boiler.h: A boiler gives draft by itself, no hands on the bellows.
quasium.research.research_draft_boiler.p: The smoke boiler pushes draft by itself, no hands on the bellows: water and fuel give %s T/s. Its tank holds %s ml of water and it drinks %s ml a second. While it burns it smokes: the smoke density of its chunk grows by %s a minute.
quasium.research.research_draft_quasium_: The widest pipes and the fan made for them.
The quasium fan is the strongest generator: %s T/s. It eats Ember notes, 1 ml per %s seconds, its tank holds %s ml.
quasium.research.research_smog_ventilati: Ventilation pulls smoke out of the chunks around it.

Ventilation pulls smoke density out of the 3x3 chunks around it, %s per minute from each, and asks for %s T/s. The kaifometer on a block shows the density. Thick smoke gives bonuses and then turns into smog, and ventilation clears that too: a level per %s minutes of draft. More in the Smoke Density and Smog entry.

quasium.research.research_mind_charcoal_: The calloud of the hookah you smoked last, and the calloud of your backpack hookah, cool %s%% slower.

quasium.research.research_mind_sommelier: The tobacco tooltip shows whether you will like a flavor, even before the first try. The aroma vial speaks too: sniff it with a right click and the flavor goes into the list in the Flavored Tobacco entry.

quasium.research.research_mirror_hook.hi: A hook of Dream Quartz, an echo shard and ash. With it a kaif coma leads into the Smokelands.
quasium.research.research_mirror_hook.pa: The node gives you the Looking Glass Hook right away. Keep it in your inventory and do not lose it.
When an overdose drops you into a kaif coma for %s s, the hook catches on the smoke: this is the way into the Smokelands.
