quasium.progression.research.title: Smoke Codex: Research
quasium.progression.research.hint: Read notes with the kaifometer, and your thoughts start to line up.
quasium.progression.research.page1: Insight builds up from first kaifometer scans and from high kaif. At the research table it turns into treatises: paper, an ink sac and %s insight, the quill writes for %s s. Press Write and the table takes the insight.
quasium.progression.research.page2: On the right side of the book are the research tabs, the branches. A node costs treatises, insight and notes in bottles by tier, from I to IV. Requirements and price are on the node page, the Research button is at the bottom.
quasium.progression.research.page3: Treatises by tier: %s. Insight: %s. Ml of every note: %s.
quasium.progression.research.page4: Some nodes ask for a state: kaif at least some number. Tier IV nodes ask for something lived through: a second stage overdose, any dream or kaif %s or more.
quasium.progression.research.page5: The first tier II node asks you to pick a school, once. Hookah Way: notes for nodes cost %s%% less, kaif conditions stay. Tea Way: insight costs %s%% less, kaif conditions are gone. Schools do not change the prices of mastery perks.
quasium.progression.research.page6: A node opens a spell, a recipe, a perk or an item. The Looking Glass branch shows only to those who once sank to kaif %s, and you can study it only in that state.
quasium.progression.kaifometer_screen.hi: Smoke until your kaif rises above zero.
quasium.progression.kaifometer_screen.pa: Right click with the kaifometer while the other hand is empty to open a screen with tabs: kaif and rank, notes, tolerance, zone and bonuses, statistics, smoker passport and dream journal.

Perception depends on kaif: from %s you see item notes, from %s mob notes, from %s the ruins of the First, and at %s or lower the Looking Glass opens. A line shows up in the kaifometer once you feel it yourself: scan an item and a mob, see the ruins, step into the Looking Glass.
Notes are read as before: right click a block or a mob, or hold an item in the other hand. The first scan of anything gives insight.
quasium.progression.tolerance.title: Tolerance
quasium.progression.tolerance.hint: Find or craft your first tobacco.
quasium.progression.tolerance.page1: Every %s g of one flavor adds %s tolerance to it, the cap is %s. Every game hour the tolerance of every flavor drops by %s.
quasium.progression.tolerance.page2: Kaif from a flavor you like is multiplied by one hundred minus tolerance, in percent: five sessions of one flavor cut a tenth. Rotate flavors. The bars are on the Tolerance tab of the kaifometer.
quasium.progression.insight_mastery.page: While kaif stays at %s or more, one insight drips in every %s s. The usual insight cap is %s.
Mastery perks open in the research tree. Such a perk costs only insight: it needs no treatises or notes.
Enlightenment: hold kaif at 100 for %s s. Quasium ore within %s blocks glows through the stone for %s s, and you get %s insight. The next one comes no sooner than %s ticks later.
quasium.progression.dreams.title: Dreams and Nightmares
quasium.progression.dreams.page1: Fall asleep with kaif %s or more and sleep through the night: you get one dream. Chances out of a hundred: inspiration %s, compass %s, recipe %s, insight %s, lucid dream %s.
quasium.progression.dreams.page2: Inspiration: until sunset every bottle from the essence press is %s%% fuller. Smoke compass: for %s s after waking smoke points the way to a geode or quasium ore.
quasium.progression.dreams.page3: A recipe in a dream reveals a hidden spell you do not know yet, and if you know them all it gives insight instead. Insight: +%s. Lucid dream: you pick any other outcome yourself.
quasium.progression.dreams.page4: A nightmare comes at kaif %s or lower: your insomnia does not reset, and for %s s after waking you see things that are not there.
quasium.progression.dreams.page5: Every dream goes into the dream journal, a tab of the kaifometer.
quasium.progression.overdose_stages.page: Overdose counts grams of tobacco over %s min: from %s g a normal one, from %s g a heavy one, from %s g a kaif coma.

At the heavy stage hallucinations take flesh: smoke phantoms circle around and drain %s kaif per second when they get closer than %s blocks. A phantom crumbles from one hit and sometimes drops delirium essence.
Kaif coma: for %s s you lie unconscious and cannot move. You come to hungry, minus %s food, with kaif %s, and the overdose window is cleared.
quasium.progression.hookah_ghost.title: Hookah Ghost
quasium.progression.hookah_ghost.page1: At night, when your kaif falls to %s or lower, a hookah ghost may appear nearby, no farther than %s blocks and no more than once a night.
quasium.progression.hookah_ghost.page2: Right click the ghost to open the deal: +%s kaif right away for %s emeralds or %s experience levels.
quasium.progression.hookah_ghost.page3: The price: +%s tolerance to every flavor, and for %s ticks kaif fades %s times faster. You can refuse, then the ghost dissolves until the next night.
quasium.progression.withdrawal.title: Withdrawal
quasium.progression.withdrawal.hint: Smoke until your kaif rises above zero.
quasium.progression.withdrawal.page1: Withdrawal is a hunger for smoke, it comes after a long pause without tobacco. The world stays the same, but the body turns sluggish and jumpy: below %s kaif your hands shake, and while you draw a bow or crossbow the camera trembles. You can tone the shaking down in the quasium-mind config, screenShakePct.
quasium.progression.withdrawal.page2: Below %s fatigue sets in: you dig slower, as with Mining Fatigue I.
quasium.progression.withdrawal.page3: The cure is kaif: smoke a flavor you like, drink a cup of tea, wait while kaif creeps back to zero, or make a deal with the ghost. A tea party at the samovar pulls you out of withdrawal fastest.
quasium.progression.stats_titles.title: Statistics and Titles
quasium.progression.stats_titles.hint: Smoke until your kaif rises above zero.
quasium.progression.stats_titles.page1: The mod keeps statistics: grams of tobacco, puffs, casts, minutes in a kaif zone, overdoses, note profiles and hybrids. They are in the vanilla statistics and in the kaifometer.
quasium.progression.stats_titles.page2: Titles: Sommelier for %s flavors, Geneticist for every first generation hybrid, Iron Lungs for %s puffs, Night Guest for a deal with the ghost, Hookah Tourist for puffs in twelve places of the world, Outsmoked the Sultan for beating a Sultan of four vows. They go into the smoker passport.
quasium.progression.bestiary.title: Bestiary
quasium.progression.bestiary.page1: Read a mob with the kaifometer at kaif %s or more, and from then on every such mob you kill drops bottles of its notes.
quasium.progression.bestiary.page2: Phantom: Menthol 2 and Ash 1. Ghast: Dew 3 and Ember 2. Witch: Nectar 2 and Ash 2. Blaze: Ember 4. Enderman: Menthol 2 and Resin 2. Creeper: Ash 2 and Ember 1.
quasium.progression.bestiary.page3: Slime: Dew 2 and Resin 1. Guardian: Dew 3 and Ember 1. Warden: Ash 4 and Menthol 4. Skeleton: Ash 3. Zombie: Ash 2 and Resin 1. Pig: Resin 1, everything has notes.
quasium.progression.bestiary.page4: Studied mobs and their notes are on the Notes tab of the kaifometer.

quasium.progression.ritual_brazier.title: Ritual Brazier
quasium.progression.ritual_brazier.hint: Opens once you make a quasium anvil or smoke in a tier two zone.
quasium.progression.ritual_brazier.page1: The brazier is a big calloud for rituals. Put it on the middle block of a 3 by 3 platform of quasium blocks. Without the full platform it will not light.
quasium.progression.ritual_brazier.page2: Put pedestals around, %s to %s blocks from the brazier, level with it or one block lower. The brazier counts up to %s of the nearest. Right click with an item puts it on a pedestal, an empty hand takes it back.
quasium.progression.ritual_brazier.page3: To start a ritual: put the catalyst into the brazier with a right click, lay the needed items on the pedestals, place note jars within %s blocks and strike the brazier with flint and steel or a fire charge. Until the ritual burns, hitting the brazier takes the catalyst back.
quasium.progression.ritual_brazier.page4: A right click on the brazier with an empty hand prints the whole list to the chat at once: the platform, the catalyst and its ritual, every pedestal item, the research, the notes in the jars and the average kaif of all players within %s blocks. Every line is marked: ok or no. Rituals of tier %s and higher light only while someone nearby stands in a Nirvana zone.
quasium.progression.ritual_brazier.page5: While the ritual burns, the notes leave the jars in smoke jets, and two bars hang on top: progress and instability. When progress fills up, the result pops out of the brazier on top. The ritual leaves %s smoke in the chunk.
quasium.progression.ritual_draft.title: Brazier Rhythm and Instability
quasium.progression.ritual_draft.hint: Opens once you make a quasium anvil or smoke in a tier two zone.
quasium.progression.ritual_draft.page1: A burning brazier beats: the coals flare, a smoke ring closes in on them and a low thump sounds. A tier 1 ritual beats every %s ms, a tier 4 one every %s ms. Attach a pipe to the brazier with Shift+right click and take a short puff on every beat. You can look right at the brazier, short puffs cost no air.
quasium.progression.ritual_draft.page2: A draft network helps the rhythm: pipes hook right onto the brazier, and it asks for as many T/s as the recipe shows. At full draft the ritual runs on its own at %s%% of a perfect rhythm, and beats nobody puffs on do not rock it. With less draft the network helps less.
quasium.progression.ritual_draft.page3: Instability starts at the base of the ritual. A hit takes %s off, a puff off the beat adds %s, a beat nobody puffs on adds %s. On top of that every beat adds the base minus the average kaif of participants divided by %s, all divided by %s. The higher the tier, the higher the base and the tighter the rhythm it needs. If the jars run dry, the ritual stops and waits, and its instability slowly grows.
quasium.progression.ritual_draft.page4: If instability reaches %s, the ritual breaks: a smoke blast without damage, the catalyst and the pedestal items drop whole, and %s%% of the notes already used flow back into the jars nearby. With no jars around, the notes drop as bottles. Participants lose %s kaif, the chunk gets %s more smoke, and a smokeling crawls out of it. A finished ritual smokes too: the chunk gets %s smoke.
quasium.progression.ritual_draft.page5: Hits of all players add up, each keeps their own streak. If at least %s different players hit the beat in the last %s seconds, the base instability drops by %s. A harnessed backpack hookah also beats into the brazier, no pipe on the brazier needed.
quasium.progression.ritual_draft.page6: A focus filter can be set into the brazier itself with a right click: it takes %s off the base instability. Hit the brazier to take the filter out when it holds no catalyst.
quasium.progression.ritual_artifacts.hin: Opens once you make a quasium anvil or smoke in a tier two zone.
quasium.progression.ritual_artifacts.pag: Dream Quartz: the simplest ritual, any kaif will do. An amethyst shard in the brazier gives dream quartz, and it goes onto the pedestals of other rituals.
The Eternal Coal goes into a hookah instead of a calloud. It never burns out or cools, but in return the overdose window gets %s%% of the grams you smoke.
While the Bottomless Flask is in the inventory, casts burn no tobacco, but each one costs %s kaif.
Smoke Portal: quasium blocks in the brazier and on the pedestals give a smoke portal activator. It lights the portal to the Smokelands.
The Void Pipe is not made at the brazier: it lies in End city chests, %s%% chance. In the inventory casts write no overdose grams, but below %s g in the bowl each cast costs %s health.
The Signal Pipe is crafted. A right click raises a smoke column %s blocks high and tells everyone your coordinates and the name of the pipe: rename it on an anvil, up to %s letters. Cooldown %s s.
quasium.progression.ritual_gear.title: Harness, Carapace and Boots
quasium.progression.ritual_gear.hint: Opens once you make a quasium anvil or smoke in a tier two zone.
quasium.progression.ritual_gear.page1: Quasium Harness: a backpack hookah into the brazier, a quasium ingot and dream quartz onto the pedestals. The hookah stays the same, the harness goes right onto it, and the straps show on your back.
quasium.progression.ritual_gear.page2: With the harness the lungs hold %s%% of the usual, rings recharge in %s%% of the time, and pulling from the backpack hookah does not slow you down. If a ritual burns within %s blocks, your puffs also go into the brazier.
quasium.progression.ritual_gear.page3: The Smoke Carapace is made from a quasium chestplate. Wear the whole quasium set with it: the armor darkens with smoke, and the carapace stores the damage you take. At %s it exhales a nova: %s%% of the charge as damage to mobs within %s blocks.
quasium.progression.ritual_gear.page4: Smokestep goes onto any boots, leather or from another mod. The boots stay themselves, enchantments and durability included, and a jump in midair dashes you forward once every %s s. Fall damage is %s%% of the usual.
quasium.progression.ritual_gear.page5: Smoke Thread: any quasium armor piece into the brazier, a string onto a pedestal. Every threaded piece gives the full set +%s%% dodge, up to %s%%.

quasium.progression.smoke_portal.title: Smoke Portal
quasium.progression.smoke_portal.hint: Opens once you hold quasium blocks or find a ruined smoke portal.
quasium.progression.smoke_portal.page1: The smoke portal is built of quasium blocks: a frame 4 wide and 5 tall with an empty 2 by 3 inside. Light it with Eternal Coal or a portal activator from the brazier: right click the inside of the frame.
quasium.progression.smoke_portal.page2: The smoke lets through anyone with kaif %s or more. Stand in it for %s s and it carries you away. A sober player is pushed back out: I feel I'm not in the right state.
quasium.progression.smoke_portal.page3: Where you come out, the smoke builds a return portal of petrified smoke. Step into it to go back to where you left from.
quasium.progression.smokelands.title: The Smokelands
quasium.progression.smokelands.hint: Opens when you light a smoke portal or reach the Smokelands.
quasium.progression.smokelands.page1: The Sultan, the strongest of the First Smokers, exhaled the Smokelands. There is no sun: the sky pulses in draft cycles, one cycle lasts %s s. A clock shows the cycle, a compass spins.
quasium.progression.smokelands.page2: Beds and respawn anchors explode here like in the Nether: you cannot set a spawn point in the Smokelands. Smokelands mobs do not burn, but Frost Breath hits them twice as hard.
quasium.progression.smokelands_biomes.hi: Opens when you reach the Smokelands.
quasium.progression.smokelands_biomes.pa: Ash Dunes: ash sand falls like sand but does not slow you. Ash cacti prick like ordinary ones. Clots of ash and resin lie on the dunes, smoke geodes full of clots hide below, and the ruins of the First lounges stand among them.
Sea of Smoke: the smoke holds anyone with kaif %s or more, you can walk on it. Below %s you sink and lose %s kaif per second until you get out. Dream quartz grows under the bottom.

Coal Marsh: smolder glows instead of lava. It does not burn, but your feet sink in it a little, and standing on it costs %s kaif per second. Digging smolder now and then turns up Eternal Coal, and the marsh holds clots of ember and dew.
Nicotine Jungle: hookah trees, and hose vines you can climb. The poison fruit from the leaves feeds a little but poisons you. Primordial tobacco grows here, with clots of nectar, resin and menthol.
quasium.progression.cinder_storm.title: Cinder Storm
quasium.progression.cinder_storm.hint: Opens when you reach the Smokelands.
quasium.progression.cinder_storm.page1: Every %s to %s s a cinder storm covers the Smokelands for %s s. Ash eats %s%% of the view and the storm knocks %s%% of casts aside. Usually %s dymniks roam around every player, in a storm %s times as many.
quasium.progression.smokelands_resources: Opens when you reach the Smokelands.

Budding dream quartz grows buds, and buds grow into clusters. A cluster gives Dream Quartz, a bud comes off only with silk touch. The budding block itself cannot be mined.
A primordial tobacco bush ripens on its own. Right click a ripe bush for %s leaves, a ripe bush drops seeds when broken. Ash of Time now and then drops from a mist phantom.
Ash Sachet: Ash of Time, paper and string. Right click the sachet to clear the longest item cooldown in your inventory at once.
Ash stone turns into ash bricks.
quasium.progression.smokelands_mobs.hint: Opens when you reach the Smokelands.
quasium.progression.smokelands_mobs.page: A dymnik that spends %s s in the Smokelands or where the smoke density is %s or more turns into a garevshchik. A garevshchik that drifts over the Sea of Smoke for %s s turns into a mist phantom.
Mist phantom: %s health, a bite for %s and Nausea for %s s. Now and then it drops Dream Quartz, more rarely Ash of Time.

quasium.progression.draft_wisp.hint: Opens when you reach the Smokelands.
quasium.progression.draft_wisp.page1: The draft wisp floats over the dunes and the jungle, it has %s health. Right click it with a honey bottle to tame it: the wisp hides in a Wisp Flute and the bottle comes back empty.
quasium.progression.draft_wisp.page2: Right click the flute to let the wisp out or call it back. It flies next to you, gives light %s, keeps a small zone of %s blocks around itself where kaif does not drop, and makes quasium ore glow within %s blocks. While it serves, the wisp takes no damage.
quasium.progression.smoke_ruins.title: Ruins of the Lounges
quasium.progression.smoke_ruins.hint: Opens when you reach the Smokelands.
quasium.progression.smoke_ruins.page1: The dunes, marshes and jungle hold ruins of the First lounges: a lounge, a colonnade and a hall. The floors are laid with mosaics of the six notes, and each ruin hides one chest.
quasium.progression.smoke_ruins.page2: Only someone with kaif %s or more sees the ruins. A sober player walks past a flat patch in the ash. Come within %s blocks of it with enough kaif and the ruins rise out of the smoke. Once shown, they stand for everyone.
quasium.progression.sultan_of_smoke.hint: Opens when you reach the Smokelands.
quasium.progression.sultan_of_smoke.page: A map from the ruins of the First leads to a throne amid the ash. The Sultan sleeps until someone comes close. He cannot be taken from afar: an arrow shot from the edge of the arena melts in the smoke before it lands.

He breathes rings, and they sting. Now and then the Sultan inhales the whole arena at once: he pulls you in, drinks the air from your lungs and the joy from your head. Whoever saves breath and keeps off the throne lasts longer.
A wounded Sultan grows angry. The air around him turns poisonous, and smokelings step out of the smoke at his call.
Near the end the coal in his crown dims now and then, as if the Sultan were tired. He has no love for Dew: a cold drop at such a moment knocks him off his feet, and blows sink deeper.

Miss the moment and the crown flares up again, its heat striking out in every direction. Those who came back from the arena say a cool bowl and smoke of your own at hand are worth more there than a sword.

Reward: a Bottomless Flask if nobody in the arena has one, %s Dream Quartz, Eternal Coal and the Ash Lo-Fi disc. After %s game days the Calling the Sultan ritual brings him back: a brazier in his arena, Ash of Time in the brazier and petrified smoke on the pedestals.
quasium.progression.lore_1.title: Diary of the First, page 1: The First Puff
quasium.progression.lore_1.hint: Find page 1 in an abandoned lounge or in the Smokelands ruins and paste it into the book.
quasium.progression.lore_1.page1: Today old Ibad breathed out, and in that smoke I heard his voice. Not with my ears. He was thinking of his daughter, and I saw her face until the ring fell apart. We smoked till morning to test it: smoke keeps taste, sound, even anger. Only not for long, the wind carries it off. We decided to build walls and a roof so a breath could not leave. That was the first lounge.
quasium.progression.lore_2.title: Diary of the First, page 2: The Smoke That Stayed
quasium.progression.lore_2.hint: Find page 2 in a quasium geode or in the Smokelands ruins and paste it into the book.
quasium.progression.lore_2.page1: Ibad holds his breath for half a day. He says that is how a thought reaches the bottom. Yesterday he coughed, and a pebble fell into his palm, purple and warm. Now we find them wherever we smoked long: veins in the rock, hollow stones under our houses. Inside they hum quietly, like a chest before the exhale. A sober eye cannot see them, slate and nothing more.
quasium.progression.lore_3.title: Diary of the First, page 3: King of the Hookah
quasium.progression.lore_3.hint: Find page 3 in the Smokelands ruins and paste it into the book.
quasium.progression.lore_3.page1: Harun goes longer than any of us without breathing out. We call him the Sultan, it was a joke at first. He wove himself a crown of calloud and wears the coals right on his head, they never go out, day or night. Now when he speaks, everyone in the lounge has the same taste in their mouth. I do not like it. Ibad says I am just jealous.
quasium.progression.lore_4.title: Diary of the First, page 4: The Exhaled World
quasium.progression.lore_4.hint: Find page 4 in the Smokelands ruins and paste it into the book.
quasium.progression.lore_4.page1: Harun said thoughts are lost when people part, and he would not allow it anymore. He drew in, and the lounge slid into his chest: tables, walls, the people sitting there. Then the city. I stood on a hill and watched him breathe out. The smoke did not scatter. It lay down as dunes, a sea, smoldering marshes, and stayed somewhere next to our world, but not in it.
quasium.progression.lore_5.title: Diary of the First, page 5: Ash of Time
quasium.progression.lore_5.hint: Find page 5 in an abandoned lounge or in the Smokelands ruins and paste it into the book.
quasium.progression.lore_5.page1: Those who followed the Sultan into his smoke did not all come back. Time burns there like tobacco in a bowl. Stay a while and you start to smolder yourself, then you rise as a smokeling and forget your name. They leave a grey ash behind, a strange one: rub a pinch and there is nothing left to wait for. We who did not go are moving down. We laid a lounge of dark stone, deep, where there is no wind. Here we will finish our smoke.
quasium.progression.lore_6.title: Diary of the First, page 6: Dew on the Coals
quasium.progression.lore_6.hint: Find page 6 in the Smokelands ruins and paste it into the book.
quasium.progression.lore_6.page1: I am writing by the throne, my hand shakes. Harun's crown burns too hot, and near the end its coals go dark, as if he is tired. In such a moment I splashed dew on him from my flask, and he choked, fell silent, went hollow. If someone finds this: do not stand where he breathes in. And keep dew at hand while the crown is dim.
Collect all six diary pages and outlive the Sultan.
The Sultan scattered, but his throne remembers him: in %s days the smoke thickens again. The First are not gone. They are in every puff and in every vein of quasium.
The quasium in your pocket is the breath of someone who once sat in a lounge just like yours. Smoke with care.

quasium.progression.leaf_quality.title: Leaf Quality
quasium.progression.leaf_quality.hint: Not all leaves are equal: each has its own stars.
quasium.progression.leaf_quality.page1: Every cut leaf has its own quality, 1 to 5 stars, shown in the leaf tooltip. One star is always there, the harvest can add three more, and the barrel gives the fifth.
quasium.progression.leaf_quality.page2: A star for timing: cut the bush within %s seconds after it ripens. An overripe bush loses only this star.
quasium.progression.leaf_quality.page3: A star for water: the farmland under the bush is soaking wet, or the bush itself was watered from a bucket. Farmland gets wet when there is water nearby.
quasium.progression.leaf_quality.page4: A star for bees: a beehive or bee nest with honey within %s blocks of the bush. An empty hive does not count.
quasium.progression.leaf_quality.page5: A barrel without sugar adds one more star, up to 5. Sugar speeds fermentation up but gives no star.
quasium.progression.leaf_quality.page6: The leaf's stars carry over into the self-mix pack and set its kaif: %s%% of the normal amount for 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 stars.
quasium.progression.leaf_quality.page7: In the distillation cube a leaf adds %s ml to its main note for 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 stars. The hookah master and the smoke caravan value stars too, they have their own entries.
quasium.progression.aphids.title: Aphids
quasium.progression.aphids.page1: Once per in-game day a growing bush can catch aphids, a %s%% chance. Midges swarm over a sick bush, and it grows at %s%% of the normal speed. Aphids do not spoil the leaves or their stars.
quasium.progression.aphids.page2: Flowers keep aphids away: any flower within %s blocks of the bush lowers the chance by %s%%.
quasium.progression.aphids.page3: Smoke the aphids out: right-click a sick bush with an Ember note bottle. It takes %s ml, and the bush grows at full speed again.
quasium.progression.rare_varieties.title: Rare Varieties
quasium.progression.rare_varieties.hint: A leaf can sprout a new variety.
quasium.progression.rare_varieties.page1: The soaking bowl can grow seeds. Put a fermented leaf in it and add a catalyst instead of essence and molasses. Stir with a stick, and after 30 seconds the bowl holds one seed instead of a self-mix, take it with an empty bowl.
quasium.progression.rare_varieties.page2: An echo shard with any leaf gives Echo Leaf seeds, blaze powder with Peschanik gives Ashen, chorus fruit with Dikar gives Chorus. Ashen seeds also turn up in Nether fortress chests, Chorus seeds in End city chests.
quasium.progression.rare_varieties.page3: Rare varieties need their own soil. Echo Leaf grows only on sculk, Ashen on soul soil, Chorus on end stone or farmland, but twice as slow outside the End. All of them need light, so bring some into the Deep Dark.
quasium.progression.rare_varieties.page4: A self-mix of Echo Leaf muffles your vibrations for %s seconds on every exhale: sculk sensors, shriekers and the warden do not hear you. The warden can still smell you, so do not get close.
quasium.progression.rare_varieties.page5: A self-mix of Ashen gives Fire Resistance for %s seconds, and the exhale comes out as fire: the cloud hits everyone in its way for %s damage and sets them on fire for %s seconds. It never touches you.
quasium.progression.rare_varieties.page6: A self-mix of Chorus blinks you where you look on the exhale, up to %s blocks, to the last free spot before a wall. The next blink is ready %s seconds later.
quasium.progression.rare_varieties.page7: A wild primordial bush grows only in the Smokelands, in the nicotine jungle, and its seeds sometimes lie in ruin chests. Primordial leaves give twice the notes in the distillation cube.
quasium.progression.quasium_geode.title: Quasium Geode
quasium.progression.quasium_geode.hint: Geodes hide deep in the slate, but a sober eye won't see them.
quasium.progression.quasium_geode.page1: Quasium geodes lie deep, from height -58 to -10. While you have less than %s kaif, their crust looks like deepslate. At that kaif and above the crust shimmers with violet veins, and the geode hums when you are within %s blocks.
quasium.progression.quasium_geode.page2: Under the crust lies a layer of calcite, and inside it budding quasium. Buds grow on it by themselves: small, medium, large, then a cluster. Budding quasium cannot be mined, it crumbles even from a piston, while the crust comes off with a plain pickaxe.
quasium.progression.quasium_geode.page3: A cluster gives raw quasium only if you have at least %s kaif: %s to %s pieces, and the higher your kaif, the more generous it is. Buds give nothing. Silk Touch takes buds and clusters whole.
quasium.progression.quasium_geode.page4: Every geode holds a chest: one to three note bottles of 20 ml, page 2 of the diary of the First, and sometimes a secret recipe.
quasium.progression.hookah_master.title: Hookah Master
quasium.progression.hookah_master.hint: A hookah master lives in villages.
quasium.progression.hookah_master.page1: The hookah master is a villager whose workstation is the essence press. He lives in his own hut in plains, savanna, taiga, snowy and desert villages. Any jobless villager next to a free press becomes one too.
quasium.progression.hookah_master.page2: The hookah master buys leaves of wild varieties, each deal names its own variety. A novice takes leaves in any state, %s for an emerald, and from level two dried ones, %s for %s.
quasium.progression.hookah_master.page3: After that he cares about quality stars, exactly as many as he asks for: %s leaves of 3 stars for %s emeralds, a 4-star leaf for %s, a 5-star leaf for %s.
quasium.progression.hookah_master.page4: He sells ready flavored tobacco, one pack a deal. On the first two levels simple flavors cost %s emeralds: mint, apple, watermelon, vanilla, berry and citrus.
quasium.progression.hookah_master.page5: From level three rare flavors cost %s emeralds: coffee, anise, cherry, grape, rose, coconut and cinnamon. Instead of such a pack he may offer a catalyst for rare varieties: %s blaze powder for %s emeralds, %s chorus fruit for %s or an echo shard for %s.
quasium.progression.hookah_master.page6: Apart from flavored tobacco, the hookah master sells no mod items. Note bottles, wild seeds and a Dikar x Peschanik hybrid lie in the chest of his hut, sometimes with a rare bulb.
quasium.progression.smoke_caravan.title: Smoke Caravan
quasium.progression.smoke_caravan.hint: Sometimes a trader with llamas comes to you.
quasium.progression.smoke_caravan.page1: The smoke caravan comes on its own, but rarely. At the start of an in-game day there is a %s%% chance it appears near a random player, with two llamas on a leash, ringing its bell. While it is on the road no other caravan comes. After %s minutes of game time it leaves with its llamas, even if you went far away.
quasium.progression.smoke_caravan.page2: Flavor source bundles per visit: %s, %s emeralds each, at most %s purchases each. Which ones depends on the day he arrives: apples, melon slices, glow berries, sugar, cocoa beans, blaze powder, pink petals, sweet berries, honeycomb, ice, ferns or nether wart. He also brings %s random flavored tobaccos at the hookah master's prices, %s packs of each.
quasium.progression.smoke_caravan.page3: The caravan also buys a good self-mix: a pack of %s stars or more with at least %s g left, for %s emeralds, up to 4 packs per visit.
quasium.progression.abandoned_lounge.hin: Deep underground someone smoked long before you.
quasium.progression.abandoned_lounge.pag: Underground, from height -24 to 16, you may come across an abandoned lounge: a room of deepslate bricks with an old hookah, cushions, bones and cobwebs. There is at most one per area of 40 by 40 chunks. A cartographer of level 2 sells a map to the nearest one for %s emeralds and a compass.
The lounge chest holds two diary pages of the First and the ancient mix: a 5-star self-mix pack with double kaif.
Sometimes it also holds a rare modular hookah bulb, jade, violet or gold, or a secret recipe. Neither can be crafted.

Right click a page to paste it into this book and open its entry in the diary of the First. There are six pages: the lounge holds pages 1 and 5, a quasium geode page 2, and 3, 4 and 6 lie only in the ruins of the Smokelands.
quasium.progression.soaking_bowl.page6: Instead of essence and molasses the bowl can take a catalyst: an echo shard, blaze powder or chorus fruit. After stirring the leaf sprouts into a seed of a rare variety, take it with an empty bowl. The Rare Varieties entry tells which leaf sprouts with which catalyst.
quasium.progression.soaking_bowl.page7: Every world has its own secret mix of two essences. A secret recipe from geode and abandoned lounge chests names it. A self-mix with exactly these two essences and no third gives %s%% more kaif.
quasium.hint.selection.title: Breeding hybrids
quasium.hint.selection.1: A pole only crosses different varieties: two Dikar bushes will not cross with each other.
quasium.hint.selection.2: Dikar and Peschanik will do. First the pole rolls its luck: wooden 70%%, reinforced 85%%, golden 95%%, diamond always.
quasium.hint.selection.3: On a success the hybrid roll comes next: 5-15%% by pole, and every star of the parents' average quality adds %s%% of that chance. Otherwise a seed of one parent grows.
quasium.hint.selection.4: A hybrid is named after its parents, Dikar x Peschanik for example. Each of its stars is the parents' average plus or minus one.
quasium.hint.selection.5: Every new hybrid joins your collection in the Cross-Breeding entry. The six pairs of the four wild varieties are the first generation.
quasium.hint.leaf_quality.title: Leaf quality
quasium.hint.leaf_quality.1: Every cut leaf has 1 to 5 quality stars, one is always there. Cut the bush within %s seconds after it ripens for a second one.
quasium.hint.leaf_quality.2: Wet farmland or a bush watered from a bucket gives another star.
quasium.hint.leaf_quality.3: A beehive or bee nest with honey within %s blocks of the bush gives a third.
quasium.hint.leaf_quality.4: A barrel without sugar adds one more star, up to 5. Sugar is faster but gives no star.
quasium.hint.leaf_quality.5: Stars set the kaif of a self-mix pack: %s%% of normal for 1-5 stars. In the distillation cube a leaf adds %s ml to its main note for the same stars.
quasium.hint.aphids.title: Aphids and smoking them out
quasium.hint.aphids.1: Once per in-game day a growing bush can catch aphids, a %s%% chance. Midges swarm over a sick bush, and it grows at %s%% speed.
quasium.hint.aphids.2: Flowers within %s blocks of the bush lower the aphid chance by %s%%.
quasium.hint.aphids.3: Smoke the aphids out: right-click the sick bush with an Ember note bottle. It takes %s ml.
quasium.hint.aphids.4: The bush grows at full speed again. Aphids never spoil the leaves or their stars.
quasium.hint.rare_varieties.title: Rare varieties
quasium.hint.rare_varieties.1: Rare varieties grow from a seed the soaking bowl makes: a fermented leaf and a catalyst instead of essence. Stir with a stick and take the seed with an empty bowl.

quasium.progression.backpack_hookah.page: A hookah on your back is easy to carry around the world. Take a puff from any hookah in twelve places: a desert or badlands, snow, a jungle, a swamp, a mushroom island, a cherry grove, the deep dark, an ocean, a height of 200 blocks or more, the Nether, the End and the Smokelands. All twelve give the A Puff at the Edge of the World advancement and the Hookah Tourist title.

quasium.progression.golem_programs.title: Golem Programs
quasium.progression.golem_programs.hint: A program table gives a clay golem a program of blocks instead of a job.
quasium.progression.golem_programs.page1: A place marker remembers a block and its face: right-click a block, shift+right-click the air clears it. The tooltip shows the coordinates and the face, and while the marker is in hand the stored block glows with particles. The marker goes into slot A or B of a program block: the place is copied into the block, the marker itself stays in your hand, ready to mark the next place.
quasium.progression.golem_programs.page2: The program table window is wider than usual: the block palette by groups on the left, the scrolling program on the right, the inventory below. Drag a block from the palette with the mouse, and it snaps into the stack or inside a bracket. Program blocks drag too, and a block dragged off the edge of the program is deleted. A place more than %s blocks from the table or in another dimension is out of the golem's reach, and a block with such a place does nothing.
quasium.progression.golem_programs.page3: From the start there are Go to A, Break A, Take from A, Put into A, Wait N s and the For each block A..B bracket. Everything a block needs sits in the block itself: slots A and B for markers, a filter and a number. The number turns with the mouse wheel, by 10 with Shift. The filter keeps a ghost copy of an item with all its properties, and the block takes only exactly the same items: an essence of the same type, a leaf of the same variety and quality. A tool in the filter matches any tool of the same kind, whatever its wear and properties. The item itself is not used up.
quasium.progression.golem_programs.page4: Go to A: the golem walks up to block A on the side of the marked face and stands there N seconds. Break A: it walks up to the block and breaks it with the tool in hand, the drops go into its load. Put into A: it carries its load into container A through the marked face, like a hopper feeding that face (ore goes into a furnace from the top, fuel from the side), only the filter item or anything with an empty filter, at most N items, 0 means all.
quasium.progression.golem_programs.page5: Take from A: it takes what a hopper under the container would pull, the finished goods from a furnace, whatever face the marker is on. It takes the filter item, anything with an empty filter, up to N items, 0 means as many as fit. Wait N s: the golem stands still N seconds.
quasium.progression.golem_programs.page6: The For each block A..B bracket holds any number of blocks and runs them for every block of the box between A and B, nearest to the golem first. A block inside the bracket with an empty slot A works here, on the current block of the box, and quietly passes whatever it has nothing to do with: Break passes air and whatever it may not break, Put and Take pass everything that is not a container. If the first block of the bracket has nothing to do at the current spot, the other blocks of the bracket skip it too. A bracket with Break inside and Put into a chest below it: the golem clears the patch and carries the drops to the chest.
quasium.progression.golem_programs.page7: A drying shelf, a barrel and a self-mix bowl are containers too: the shelf takes raw items and gives back only dried ones, the barrel takes dried leaves of one batch, starts fermenting at once and gives back only finished leaves, the bowl takes a fermented leaf and one bottle of molasses or essence, stirs by itself and gives back the self-mix and the empty bottles. This way a program takes tobacco from the field all the way to the mix.
quasium.progression.golem_programs.page8: The golem goes through the blocks top to bottom and starts over after the last one, and the block it is on is lit in the window. Loops, conditions and redstone open with the nodes of the Golems branch in the Smoke Codex. A node is needed by whoever places such a block or picks a check, while blocks already in place can be moved and deleted without it. A finished program runs on any table, and creative mode has no locks. A program holds up to %s blocks, nested ones count too, and up to %s brackets inside each other.

quasium.progression.golem_care.smoke: Give a clay golem the hookah pipe, with a right-click or through the slot on the Work tab, and it smokes with you. While you pull a burning hookah inside a zone the golem is bound to, and your last pull was at most %s s ago, the golem sits on a free cushion within %s blocks of the hookah and pulls %s s out of every %s. The tobacco burns as from a player, and the kaif zone counts the golem as a smoker. At most %s golems sit at one hookah, so you, %s golems and %s pieces of lounge furniture already make Nirvana. A golem is no ritual participant, and it gets no kaif, grams or achievements. A smoking golem gets hungry twice as fast, even in a zone where the meter usually stands still. When you stop, it gets up too. While you smoke, a golem with the pipe leaves its tobacco work even when it found no seat, and its journal says why it did not sit down. The hookah report shows how many people and how many golems smoke.

quasium.research.research_golems_countin: Loops on the program table: Repeat N times, Repeat forever and While.

Opens the Loops group in the program table palette. Repeat N times runs the blocks inside the bracket N times in a row and moves on. Repeat forever runs the bracket endlessly, the golem never gets to the blocks below it. While repeats the bracket as long as the check holds, and the check is picked in the block itself: the load is full or empty, the golem is hungry, day or night and others.
quasium.research.research_golems_forks.h: Conditions on the program table: If and If / Else.
quasium.research.research_golems_forks.p: Opens the Conditions group in the program table palette. If runs the blocks of its bracket only when the check holds, otherwise it skips them. If / Else has two brackets: the top one runs when the check holds, the bottom one when it does not.

The checks are the same as in While: the load is full, the load is empty, container A has the filter item, container A has no room for it, the golem is hungry, day, night, the filter block stands at A, A is empty. The marker and the filter for a check go right into the condition block.
Redstone on the program table: Wait for a signal on A, Press A and the check signal at A.

Opens the Redstone group in the program table palette. Wait for a signal on A holds the program while place A has no redstone signal. Press A: the golem walks up to place A and presses a button, flips a lever, opens or closes a door, trapdoor or fence gate. If, If / Else and While get the check signal at A.
item.quasium.program_card.tooltip: Carries a program between program tables
quasium.progression.golem_programs.page9: A program card is made of paper and a clay ball. It has its own slot in the table window: Save copies the table's program onto the card, Load puts the card's program on the table in place of the old one. The card keeps places as coordinates, so on another table the blocks point at the same places. Loading needs no nodes.
quasium.progression.golem_programs.page1: A golem is bound to the table with the staff, like to a mark. A clay golem with a table runs only its program: its job, harvest marks, unloading at storage, guarding and tool swaps wait. A calloud golem does not bind to tables. A golem sees its table twice as far as its marks, and when it walks farther away the program waits until it comes back. Binding to a new table unbinds the old one, and any number of golems can run one program: change the program, and all of them switch at once. An unbound golem goes back to all its usual work.

A block it cannot do goes to the journal and is skipped: it could not get there in about half a minute (longer for a sad or hungry golem), there is nothing to take, the container is full or missing, there is nothing to break with. It never breaks a block that holds something: containers, hookahs, shelves, barrels, marks, program tables, feeders. It leaves the blocks under marks and unbreakable blocks alone too, and walks past quasium ore, quasium crystals and budding blocks: only a player can mine those. On someone else's protected land the golem breaks nothing and stays out of containers, just like you.

Food and tools work as everywhere. Program work costs %s%% of the meter per stretch, like a job. A stretch ends at the end of a round or when the program halts: the load is full or a block failed. An empty meter, supper at the feeder or a table that unloaded or is too far stop the program, then the golem goes on from the same block, and that survives a reload too. A broken table loses its program and bindings, so save it to a card beforehand. Every broken block costs the tool one durability point. With the toolkeeper module the golem saves any worn tool, pickaxe and shovel too: it won't break blocks with it and says so in the journal.
quasium.hint.golem_programs.6: A card of paper and clay: Save writes the program onto it, Load puts the same program on another table.

quasium.research.research_smoke_heart.hi: Mix notebook: editing the heart of a page and the second effect of every note.
quasium.research.research_smoke_heart.pa: You can now change the heart of a page in the mix notebook. An effect only comes from a note: Frost from Menthol, Heat from Ember. The first effect of a note opens by itself as soon as a bottle of that note lands in your inventory: from the distillation cube, a jar or a clot.

The node adds the second effect of every note: Gust for Menthol, Blast for Ember, Stickiness for Nectar, Calm for Dew, Shackles for Resin, Blindness for Ash. A heart holds up to three effects. Two effects of one note are fine, one effect twice is not, that is what Power in the top is for.
quasium.research.research_smoke_bases.hi: Mix notebook: editing the base of a page, Wave and Self.
quasium.research.research_smoke_bases.pa: You can now change the base, the shape a page flies out in. Bolt, Beam, Cone and Cloud are open right away. The node adds Wave, which spreads in a ring around you, and Self, the cheapest shape: the heart effects land on you.
The Veil node opens Veil and Ring, Spiritism in the Looking Glass opens Spirit. The volume of the shape counts toward the page volume, and a page cannot be bigger than your lungs.
quasium.research.research_smoke_tops.hin: Mix notebook: the Fan, Chain, Homing, Lurk, Pierce and Silence modifiers.
quasium.research.research_smoke_tops.pag: Power, Breadth, Reach and Length sit in the top from the start, the node adds the behavior modifiers. Fan sends copies of the shape out in a fan, each hits at %s%% power. Chain throws the hit over to a target within %s blocks at %s%% of the last hit's power.

Homing turns a bolt or a ring toward the target. Lurk leaves a bolt, a cloud or a veil waiting in place until a mob comes close. Pierce takes a bolt or a beam through targets. Silence mutes the sound and almost all the particles. Not every modifier fits every shape, the notebook window will not let you place one that does not.
quasium.research.research_notes_overtone: The third effect of every note for the heart of a page.

Every note has a third, subtle effect. Clarity of Menthol takes one harmful effect off an ally and makes an enemy glow. Whisper of Ember lights up the ore around. Growth of Nectar speeds up crops and saplings. Dissolve of Dew weakens the target's armor. Carapace of Resin gives an ally damage absorption. Decay of Ash puts weakness on the target and wears its armor down.
The effect cools down, not the page. Whisper used on one page waits on every other page too, so rewriting a page will not skip the cooldown.
quasium.research.research_smoke_veil.hin: Mix notebook: Veil and Ring as the base of a page.
quasium.research.research_smoke_veil.pag: Veil puts a wall of thick smoke in front of you. Mobs behind it lose their target, arrows get stuck in it, and the heart effects tick on everyone inside. This shape does not so much hit as cut off sight and the way through.
Ring flies forward and touches everyone in its path once. An exhale on the beat makes a perfect ring at %s%% power, and a spell cast through your own ring hits at %s%%, like with the ring spells.
quasium.research.research_mirror_spiriti: Hookah spirits: the spirit mix, the Spirit shape, Flock, Loyalty and Taunt.
Opens the spirit mix: fermented Ashen leaves with a phantom membrane in the soaking bowl. While the mix is in the bowl, it smokes like regular tobacco and opens the Spirit shape in the base.

A spirit finds its own target, catches up with it and lays the heart of the page on it. Flock adds spirits, Loyalty keeps them around you against incoming projectiles, Taunt makes a mob hit the spirit instead of you. The rest is in the entry on hookah spirits.
quasium.progression.spell_tetrad.title: Mix Notebook
quasium.progression.spell_tetrad.page1: The mix notebook is a book of spells you write yourself. It takes a book, coal and any bottle of extract or note. The notebook has eight pages, each with its own name, and a new notebook comes with two ready pages: Frost Breath and Ember Breath.
quasium.progression.spell_tetrad.page2: The notebook works while it is in your hand or inventory. The exhale comes from the active page: R flips pages, holding R opens a wheel of eight. The page name and the colored dots of its notes show above the lungs bar. If the bowl lacks a note the page needs, the page turns gray and shows which note is missing.
quasium.progression.spell_tetrad.page3: Right click with the notebook opens it. While there is smoke in your lungs you cannot edit, exhale first. You can rename ready pages and change their top right away. The Heart node opens the heart, the Bases node opens the base, both in Smoke Research.
quasium.progression.spell_tetrad.page4: You can tear a page out into a loose sheet and give it to a friend. You can exhale someone else's page if you have the notes, but you can only edit the parts you have opened yourself. A sheet goes back into an empty spot of a notebook.
quasium.progression.spell_tetrad.page5: Without a notebook magic works the old way: if the bottles in the bowl match a spell, that spell comes out. An empty active page also takes the old way.
quasium.progression.page_pyramid.title: Page Pyramid
quasium.progression.page_pyramid.hint: Base, heart and top: what a page is made of.
quasium.progression.page_pyramid.page1: The word notes comes from perfumery, where a scent is described as a pyramid. A page works the same way. At the bottom is the base, one shape per page. In the middle is the heart, up to three effects, each from its own note. On top is the top, up to four modifiers.
quasium.progression.page_pyramid.page2: The base decides how the smoke flies. Bolt hits the first target in its way, Beam instantly hits one target far off, Cone covers everything in front of you, Cloud hangs in place and hurts a little at a time. Wave spreads from you in a ring, Self puts the effects on you, Veil stands up as a wall, Ring touches everyone in its path, Spirit finds its target on its own.
quasium.progression.page_pyramid.page3: The heart takes effects only from notes: want Frost, bring Menthol. Every note has three effects. The first opens by itself when you get your first bottle of that note, the second comes with the Heart node, the third with the Overtones node. Two effects of one note are fine, one effect twice is not. A page without a heart is empty, except for Spirit.
quasium.progression.page_pyramid.page4: The effect itself decides whom it touches. Damage and control do not touch you, your pets or your golems, and players only with PvP on. Healing, Carapace and Clarity touch only your side. In one cloud with Heat and Healing, enemies burn and friends heal. Control on players lasts shorter than on mobs.
quasium.progression.page_pyramid.page5: The top changes power and behavior. Power makes the effects stronger, but every step of it adds note cost to every effect. Breadth widens, Reach hits farther, Length stretches clouds and statuses. The Top Notes node opens the other modifiers, and Echo is found only on pages of the First in the Smokelands.
quasium.progression.page_pyramid.page6: Every part has its own smoke volume, and the page volume is their sum. The notebook window counts it, shows how many notes and grams one exhale costs, and puts together a description from the parts. You see what you get before the first exhale.
quasium.progression.exhale_resources.pag: An exhale from a page has three costs, and each one feels different. Lungs set the pace: a page is no bigger than they are, which is %s ml at the start, the Condenser adds %s, perks and the harness add more. A second of pulling fills up to %s ml, so a big page means a long pull.

Notes are the economy. Every heart effect eats a little of its note from the bowl per exhale, every step of Power as much again. The bowl has three slots, so you carry three notes, but an extract like mint carries two notes in one bottle. What you put in the bowl is what you fight with.
Grams are the risk. A page burns tobacco by how much smoke you actually drew in: %s g for every ml. The overdose window is the same, %s g in %s minutes.

Overflow. Draw in more than the page volume and the extra is not wasted: every %s ml above it adds +%s%% to the modifier the page marked as its overflow target, up to %s steps. If there is no target or it has nothing to scale, the overflow goes into overall power. A short pull makes a quick weak exhale, a long one makes a heavy and costly one.
Holding works as before: +%s%% power per second up to %s%%, a cough after %s s. Holding, overflow, a perfect ring and a kaif zone together raise power no higher than %s%%.
The effect cools down, not the page, and the cooldown is shared by the whole notebook. Rewrite a page and Shackles still wait, so the cooldown cannot be dodged.
Targets get used to notes. Hit one target with one note again and again, and every next hit is weaker. An accord resets that, so switching notes pays off and hammering with one page does not.
quasium.progression.accords.title: Accords
quasium.progression.accords.hint: Two notes in one hit sound as a third effect.
quasium.progression.accords.page1: In perfumery an accord is two notes that smell new together. Here it is a reaction: two different notes in one hit give a third effect on top of their own. Six notes make fifteen pairs, and every pair has its own accord.
quasium.progression.accords.page2: An accord sounds in two ways. Inside a page: the heart holds effects of two notes, and the accord sounds on every hit. Between hits: a hit leaves a trace of its note on the target, a colored spark, for a short while. The next hit with another note on that target sets off the accord and eats the trace.
quasium.progression.accords.page3: Traces work between players too. A friend throws a cloud of Dew, you exhale Menthol, the accord is yours. Every note sounds at its own pitch, and an accord plays the two notes together.
quasium.progression.accords.page4: An accord that sounds for the first time goes into your notebook and gives insight. An accord also resets the target getting used to notes.
quasium.progression.accords.spark: Menthol + Ember = Spark: lightning jumps to nearby targets, wet ones get hit harder.
quasium.progression.accords.lightness: Menthol + Nectar = Lightness: allies get slow falling and a high jump, enemies get tossed up.
quasium.progression.accords.rime: Menthol + Dew = Rime: a wet target freezes solid, water under the hit turns to ice and then melts by itself.
quasium.progression.accords.glaze: Menthol + Resin = Glaze: the ground around turns slippery for a while.
quasium.progression.accords.oblivion: Menthol + Ash = Oblivion: the target is thrown to a random spot nearby.
quasium.progression.accords.caramel: Ember + Nectar = Caramel: sticky fire that water does not put out, and a burning target sets its neighbors on fire by touch.
quasium.progression.accords.steam: Ember + Dew = Steam: a burn through armor and a short blindness.
quasium.progression.accords.magma: Ember + Resin = Magma: the ground under the hit burns, but fire does not stay on anything flammable.
quasium.progression.accords.smolder: Ember + Ash = Smolder: a burning target sets everyone around on fire when it dies.
quasium.progression.accords.balm: Nectar + Dew = Balm: healing stretches into regeneration for every ally nearby.
quasium.progression.accords.amber: Nectar + Resin = Amber: the target is caught in amber, cannot move and takes no damage.
quasium.progression.accords.ferment: Nectar + Ash = Ferment: nausea and hunger.
quasium.progression.accords.quagmire: Dew + Resin = Quagmire: a heavy slow, small mobs sink knee deep.
quasium.progression.accords.fog: Dew + Ash = Fog: mobs around can barely see.
quasium.progression.accords.collapse: Resin + Ash = Collapse: flyers drop to the ground and take more fall damage.
quasium.progression.hookah_spirits.title: Hookah Spirits
quasium.progression.hookah_spirits.hint: Smoke with a face that finds its own target.
quasium.progression.hookah_spirits.page1: The Spirit shape lets out a hookah spirit: a clever puff of smoke with a face that finds its own target and turns after it. Spirit needs the spirit mix in the bowl, made of Ashen leaves and a phantom membrane. The Spiritism node in the Looking Glass opens its recipe, and one pack can be found in a chest of an abandoned lounge.
quasium.progression.hookah_spirits.page2: The mix smokes like regular tobacco for every page, but burns heavier: every Spirit exhale costs extra grams. The stars of the leaf decide how clever the spirits are: every star speeds up their turn and lengthens their life.
quasium.progression.hookah_spirits.page3: How a spirit lives. It flies out of your mouth and looks around. It looks for a target: first whoever you were looking at when you exhaled, then whoever hit you last, then the nearest hostile mob. It leaves peaceful mobs, villagers and other players' pets alone unless you were looking at them.
quasium.progression.hookah_spirits.page4: A spirit chases its target and turns in flight, and if it misses, it comes around again. The hit lays the heart of the page a bit weaker than usual, since the spirit aims by itself. A bare spirit without a heart just headbutts. With no targets it circles around you and dives at the first one to show up.
quasium.progression.hookah_spirits.page5: A spirit is fragile: an arrow, a hit or an enemy's Gust blows it away. It stays out of water and lives shorter in the rain. Only a few of your spirits can fly at once. A spirit with Healing flies to a wounded ally, not to an enemy.
quasium.progression.hookah_spirits.page6: Only Spirit has Flock, Loyalty and Taunt in the top. Flock adds spirits. Loyalty keeps them around you, and they knock down incoming projectiles, each one knocked down puts out one spirit. Taunt teases first, so the mob hits the spirit instead of you. Homing turns spirits faster.
quasium.progression.hookah_spirits.page7: The face depends on the first note of the heart: sleepy for Menthol, angry for Ember, smiling for Nectar, wet eyes for Dew, sulking for Resin, empty sockets for Ash. The smoke color blends all the notes. Faces show only under kaif, a sober player just sees puffs of smoke that for some reason chase zombies.
quasium.progression.large_spell_tetrad.h: Sixteen pages from the Sultan's throne.
quasium.progression.large_spell_tetrad.p: The Sultan of Smoke drops a large mix notebook with sixteen pages. Every survivor in the arena who does not have one yet gets one, so nobody in the group waits for the next Sultan.
The large notebook comes empty. To move your old pages, tear them out of the regular notebook and put the sheets into the large one. Fire and lava do not hurt it.
The notebook is looked for in the off hand first, then the main hand, then the inventory. If you carry both, hold the large one in the off hand and the exhale comes from it.

quasium.page.form.bolt.desc: A flying puff of smoke hits the first target and makes a small burst where it lands.
quasium.page.form.beam.desc: An instant beam hits one target.
quasium.page.form.cone.desc: Smoke hits everyone in a cone in front of you.
quasium.page.form.cloud.desc: A thrown cloud hangs in place and hits everyone inside a bit weaker once a second.
quasium.page.form.wave.desc: A ring of smoke from you hits everyone around at once.
quasium.page.form.self.desc: The heart effects land on you. The cheapest base.
quasium.page.form.veil.desc: A wall of thick smoke in front of you: mobs behind it lose their target, arrows get stuck, effects tick inside.
quasium.page.form.ring.desc: A smoke ring flies forward and touches everyone on its way once. A perfect ring is stronger.
quasium.page.form.spirit.desc: A hookah spirit finds a target by itself and hits it with the page heart. Needs a spirit mix in the bowl.
quasium.page.effect.frost.desc: Damage and strong slowness. Fire mobs take double.
quasium.page.effect.clarity.desc: Clears one harmful effect from an ally, makes a foe glow.
quasium.page.effect.heat.desc: Damage and fire. Fire is weaker on a soaked target.
quasium.page.effect.blast.desc: Damage around and a push, breaks no blocks.
quasium.page.effect.healing.desc: Heals an ally, damages the undead.
quasium.page.effect.growth.desc: Crops and saplings grow as if from bone meal.
quasium.page.effect.soak.desc: Puts out fire and soaks the target: frost and spark hit it harder, fire weaker.
quasium.page.effect.calm.desc: A mob forgets its target and does not attack for a while.
quasium.page.effect.heaviness.desc: Slows, raises fall damage, drags fliers down.
quasium.page.effect.shackles.desc: The target stays in place. Half as long on players.
quasium.page.effect.choke.desc: Damage every second, no regeneration. The undead and golems do not choke, under water it is twice as strong.
quasium.page.effect.blind.desc: Blindness, a mob loses its target.
quasium.page.effect.decay.desc: Weakness, the target armor loses durability.
quasium.page.top.power.desc: Effects are stronger, but every heart note spends more essence.
quasium.page.top.length.desc: Cloud, veil and statuses last longer.
quasium.page.top.fan.desc: One more copy of the base in a fan, each a bit weaker.
quasium.page.top.flock.desc: One more spirit in the flock.
quasium.page.top.chain.desc: The hit jumps to a nearby target, weaker with every jump.
quasium.page.top.homing.desc: Bolt and ring turn toward the target, spirits turn faster.
quasium.page.top.lurk.desc: A bolt, cloud or veil waits in place and goes off when a mob comes near.
quasium.page.top.pierce.desc: Bolt and beam go through targets.
quasium.page.top.silence.desc: No sound and almost no particles.
quasium.page.top.echo.desc: A second later the page exhales once more, weaker. Found only on pages of the First.
quasium.page.top.loyalty.desc: Spirits circle around you and knock down flying projectiles.
quasium.page.top.taunt.desc: A spirit taunts a mob, so it hits the spirit instead of you.
quasium.page.accord.spark.desc: Lightning jumps to nearby targets, twice as strong on soaked ones.
quasium.page.accord.lightness.desc: Allies get slow falling and jump, foes get tossed up.
quasium.page.accord.rime.desc: A soaked target freezes solid, water under the hit turns to ice.
quasium.page.accord.oblivion.desc: The target is thrown to a random spot nearby.
quasium.page.accord.caramel.desc: Sticky fire: water does not put it out, a burning target sets neighbours alight.
quasium.page.accord.steam.desc: A burn through armor and short blindness.
quasium.page.accord.magma.desc: The ground under the hit burns, fire does not stay on flammable blocks.
quasium.page.accord.smolder.desc: A burning target sets everyone around alight when it dies.
quasium.page.accord.balm.desc: Healing spreads into regeneration for nearby allies.
quasium.page.accord.amber.desc: The target is in amber: it does not move and takes no damage.
quasium.page.accord.quagmire.desc: Strong slowness, small mobs sink knee deep.
quasium.page.accord.collapse.desc: Fliers fall to the ground, fall damage is higher.

quasium.golem.log.program_cannot_press: Program: %s at %s can't be pressed, skipping the block
quasium.golem.log.program_area_empty: Program: the For each block bracket is empty, skipping it
quasium.program.block.go.desc: The golem walks to place A and stays there for the set number of seconds
quasium.program.block.break.desc: The golem breaks the block at place A with the tool in its hand, the drops go to its cargo
quasium.program.block.take.desc: The golem takes the filter item from container A, any item without a filter. Number: how many, all means as many as fit
quasium.program.block.put.desc: The golem puts its cargo into container A through the marked face, only the filter item if one is set. Number: at most this many, all means the whole cargo
quasium.program.block.wait.desc: The golem stands still for the set number of seconds
quasium.program.block.for_each.desc: The blocks inside run for every block of the box from A to B, nearest first. An empty place A on a block inside means the current block of the box
quasium.program.block.repeat.desc: The blocks inside run N times, then the golem moves on
quasium.program.block.forever.desc: The blocks inside run in a loop without end, the golem never gets to the blocks below
quasium.program.block.while.desc: The blocks inside run in a loop while the check holds
quasium.program.block.if.desc: The blocks inside run only if the check holds
quasium.program.block.if_else.desc: If the check holds, the upper blocks run, if not, the blocks under Else
quasium.program.block.wait_signal: Wait for a signal on A
quasium.program.block.wait_signal.desc: The golem stands still until a redstone signal reaches place A
quasium.program.block.press.desc: The golem presses the button or lever at place A, opens and closes a door, trapdoor or gate
quasium.program.check.load_full.desc: The golem's cargo is packed, nothing more fits
quasium.program.check.has_item.desc: Container A holds the filter item, any item without a filter
quasium.program.check.no_room.desc: Container A takes no more of the filter item, of any item without a filter
quasium.program.check.block_is.desc: The filter block stands at place A, any block without a filter
quasium.program.check.empty_at.desc: There is no block at place A
quasium.program.check.signal.desc: A redstone signal reaches place A
quasium.program.ui.empty: Drag blocks here from the palette on the left. The golem goes through them top to bottom and starts over
quasium.program.ui.drag_palette: Drag the block into the program on the right
quasium.program.ui.drag_program: Drag to move it. Drop it outside the program to remove it
quasium.program.ui.locked: Unlocked by the Smoke Codex node: %s
quasium.program.ui.check_locked: More checks come with the Smoke Codex node: %s
quasium.program.ui.running: A golem is on this block now
quasium.program.ui.here_desc: Empty: the block works on the current block of For each block
quasium.program.ui.place_set: Click with a place marker to copy its place here, the marker stays with you
quasium.program.ui.clear: Right-click with an empty hand to clear
quasium.program.ui.far: The place is more than %s blocks from the table or in another dimension, the block will not work with it
quasium.program.ui.filter_set: Click with an item to set a copy with all its properties, the item itself stays with you
quasium.program.ui.number: Scroll or click: +1, right-click: -1, with Shift by 10
quasium.program.ui.save_desc: Write the table program onto the card
quasium.program.ui.load_desc: Put the program from the card on the table, the old one is erased
quasium.program.ui.too_big: Does not fit: at most %s blocks and %s brackets inside each other
quasium.progression.patch_1_1.fixed_1: - a samovar on a low table now stands on the tabletop instead of hovering above it, and pushes off whatever lay there
